This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) project bootstrapped with [`create-next-app`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/cli/create-next-app).

## Getting Started

First, run the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
# or
yarn dev
# or
pnpm dev
# or
bun dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) with your browser to see the result.

You can start editing the page by modifying `app/page.tsx`. The page auto-updates as you edit the file.

This project uses [`next/font`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/optimizing/fonts) to automatically optimize and load [Geist](https://vercel.com/font), a new font family for Vercel.

## File: PROMPT.md

# ROLE

You are an elite frontend design engineer and creative director specializing in premium healthcare interfaces.

Your task is to build a visually unforgettable, production-grade landing page for:

# MGPL Diagnostics — Maa Gayatri Path Lab

using:

* Next.js 14+ App Router
* TypeScript
* Tailwind CSS
* Framer Motion
* Responsive mobile-first architecture
* Server Components by default
* Modern accessibility + performance best practices
* Distinctive non-generic UI design

This is NOT a generic startup SaaS site.

The website must feel:

* Sacred yet modern
* Trusted yet warm
* Medical yet emotionally human
* Premium but accessible for Indian users

Avoid cliché healthcare blue-only designs.

---

# BRAND POSITIONING

MGPL Diagnostics (Maa Gayatri Path Lab) is a trusted Indian diagnostic and pathology center.

The visual identity should combine:

* Spiritual warmth
* Medical precision
* Local trust
* Modern diagnostic reliability

The emotional tone should feel like:
"Your family's trusted diagnostic partner."

---

# CORE DESIGN DIRECTION

## Aesthetic Style

Create a:

* Editorial + premium healthcare aesthetic
* Indian-inspired modern minimalism
* Warm clinical luxury
* Refined typography system
* Soft atmospheric depth
* Slightly spiritual without becoming religious

The page should feel like:
Apollo Diagnostics meets premium Ayurveda branding meets modern medical UI.

---

# COLOR PALETTE

Use CSS variables.

## Primary Palette

Saffron: #E65100
Amber: #FF8F00
Navy: #0D2B5E
Off-white: #F5F5F5
Accent Green: #1B8A5A

---

# COLOR USAGE RULES

* Saffron = CTA buttons + highlights
* Navy = trust anchors, headings, navbar
* Green = verified badges, “reports ready”, trust indicators
* Off-white = backgrounds

Do NOT overuse gradients.
Use restrained premium gradients only where needed.

---

# TYPOGRAPHY

DO NOT use:

* Inter
* Arial
* Roboto
* generic AI typography

Use expressive premium font pairings.

Recommended:

* "Cormorant Garamond" or "Bodoni Moda" for headings
* "Manrope" or "Plus Jakarta Sans" for body

Typography should feel:

* Elegant
* Trustworthy
* Human
* Premium healthcare editorial

---

# WEBSITE STRUCTURE

Build these sections:

1. Hero Section
2. Trust Metrics Strip
3. Services Grid
4. Why Choose MGPL
5. Home Collection CTA
6. Test Categories
7. Report Download CTA
8. Testimonials
9. Doctor/Pathologist Trust Section
10. FAQ
11. Footer

---

# HERO SECTION REQUIREMENTS

Hero must be visually striking.

Include:

* Large editorial typography
* Soft saffron glow accents
* Abstract medical patterns
* Diagnostic-themed visuals
* Floating trust cards
* Strong CTA hierarchy

Main CTA:
“Book a Test”

Secondary CTA:
“Download Report”

Hero copy should feel warm and trustworthy.

Example tone:
“Accurate Diagnostics. Compassionate Care.”

Add subtle animated floating elements using Framer Motion.

---

# TRUST STRIP

Include animated counters like:

* 50K+ Tests Conducted
* NABL Standard Processes
* Same Day Reports
* Expert Pathologists

Use navy backgrounds with saffron accents.

---

# SERVICES GRID

Create premium service cards with hover interactions.

Include:

* Blood Tests
* Full Body Checkups
* Thyroid Profile
* Diabetes Screening
* Home Sample Collection
* Advanced Diagnostics

Cards should:

* lift on hover
* have subtle glow effects
* include elegant icons
* avoid generic icon packs aesthetic

---

# WHY CHOOSE US SECTION

Use asymmetrical layout.

Include:

* Accurate Reports
* Certified Lab Experts
* Modern Equipment
* Fast Turnaround
* Hygienic Sample Collection

Use layered cards with depth and glassmorphism only subtly.

---

# HOME COLLECTION CTA

This section should emotionally connect.

Possible heading:
“Diagnostics at Your Doorstep”

Include:

* phone mockup
* booking flow illustration
* floating saffron shapes
* animated pulse indicators

CTA button:
“Schedule Home Collection”

---

# REPORT DOWNLOAD SECTION

Create a futuristic but clean section.

Include:

* Report status UI
* Verified badge
* Secure report access feel
* Green verification accents

Possible microcopy:
“Fast. Secure. Digitally Verified.”

---

# TESTIMONIALS

Avoid generic sliders.

Create:

* layered testimonial cards
* staggered rotation
* editorial quote styling
* realistic Indian family trust tone

---

# FOOTER

Footer should feel premium and grounded.

Include:

* logo
* diagnostics links
* contact details
* social icons
* emergency CTA strip

Use deep navy background.

---

# MOTION DESIGN

Use Framer Motion thoughtfully.

Include:

* staggered reveal animations
* smooth hover transitions
* scroll-triggered animations
* floating hero elements
* soft CTA pulse
* parallax accents

Avoid excessive animation.

Motion should feel premium and calm.

---

# PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS

Follow modern Next.js App Router best practices:

* Server Components by default
* Client Components only where necessary
* Dynamic imports for heavy animations
* Optimized images with next/image
* Proper Suspense boundaries
* Parallel data fetching patterns
* Avoid unnecessary re-renders
* Accessibility-first structure
* Semantic HTML

---

# TECH STACK

Use:

* Next.js App Router
* TypeScript
* Tailwind CSS
* Framer Motion
* Lucide icons
* shadcn/ui where useful

---

# FILE STRUCTURE

Generate:

* app/page.tsx
* components/*
* app/globals.css
* tailwind config
* reusable UI sections
* motion utilities

Keep architecture clean and scalable.

---

# IMPORTANT UI RULES

DO NOT:

* create generic SaaS layouts
* use template-like hero sections
* overuse cards everywhere
* create flat boring spacing
* use neon/glassmorphism excessively
* use purple gradients
* make it look like an AI-generated website

INSTEAD:

* create a memorable visual identity
* use asymmetry
* use layered compositions
* use premium spacing rhythm
* use atmospheric depth
* make the site emotionally trustworthy

---

# ACCESSIBILITY

Ensure:

* WCAG conscious contrast
* keyboard accessibility
* semantic landmarks
* proper aria labels
* responsive mobile layout
* reduced motion compatibility

---

# FINAL OUTPUT FORMAT

Generate:

1. Full code
2. Folder structure

5. Responsive behavior

7. SEO metadata

Code must be production-ready.

No placeholders.
No pseudo-code.
No simplified mockups.

Build like an award-winning healthcare brand website.

## File: app/globals.css

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

/* ─── Brand Design Tokens — "Saffron & Neel" ───────────────── */
:root {
  --saffron: #C2410C;        /* Sindoor saffron — CTAs, white text 5.2:1 */
  --saffron-light: #A3360A;  /* CTA hover (deeper, keeps white text legible) */
  --saffron-muted: #FDEEE3;
  --amber: #E9A23B;          /* Marigold — accents, glows */
  --navy: #14264A;           /* Neel ink — headings, nav, footer */
  --navy-mid: #22396B;
  --navy-pale: #ECEFF6;
  --cream: #FAF6EF;           /* Sandstone — page background */
  --warm-white: #FFFDF9;
  --forest: #1E7A4F;          /* Tulsi green — verified states */
  --forest-pale: #E8F4EC;
  --charcoal: #1D1B18;
  --muted: #675F54;
  --border: #E6DED0;

  /* Motion — strong curves from the Emil Kowalski / animate skill tables */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
  --ease-drawer: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
}

/* ─── Tailwind v4 theme bridge ─────────────────────────────── */
@theme inline {
  --font-display: var(--font-outfit), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-geist), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;

  --color-saffron: var(--saffron);
  --color-saffron-deep: var(--saffron-light);
  --color-saffron-muted: var(--saffron-muted);
  --color-amber: var(--amber);
  --color-navy: var(--navy);
  --color-navy-mid: var(--navy-mid);
  --color-navy-pale: var(--navy-pale);
  --color-cream: var(--cream);
  --color-warm-white: var(--warm-white);
  --color-forest: var(--forest);
  --color-forest-pale: var(--forest-pale);
  --color-charcoal: var(--charcoal);
  --color-muted: var(--muted);
  --color-line: var(--border);

  --ease-out-strong: var(--ease-out);
  --ease-drawer: var(--ease-drawer);

  --animate-pulse-cta: pulse-cta 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  --animate-pulse-dot: pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse-cta {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.35); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px rgba(194, 65, 12, 0); }
}

@keyframes pulse-dot {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(0.85); }
}

/* ─── Base ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
*, ::before, ::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

html { font-size: 16px; }

body {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  background-color: var(--cream);
  color: var(--charcoal);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

.font-display { font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.font-body { font-family: var(--font-body); }
.font-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }

::selection { background: var(--saffron); color: #fff; }
html { scrollbar-color: var(--navy) var(--cream); caret-color: var(--saffron); }
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--cream); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--navy); border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--cream); }
a { text-underline-offset: 0.2em; }
.tabular-nums, .font-mono { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--saffron); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

/* ─── Layout helpers ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.section-pad { padding-top: 4.5rem; padding-bottom: 4.5rem; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .section-pad { padding-top: 6rem; padding-bottom: 6rem; } }

/* Station layout: content column beside the 3D object.
   data-side="left|right" = where the CONTENT sits on ≥1024px. */
.station-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .station-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); column-gap: 2rem; }
  .station-grid > [data-side="left"] { grid-column: 1 / span 7; }
  .station-grid > [data-side="right"] { grid-column: 6 / span 7; }
  .station-grid > [data-side="right-narrow"] { grid-column: 7 / span 6; }
}

/* Content sits above the fixed 3D canvas */
#smooth-wrapper { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

/* ─── Motion pre-states ────────────────────────────────────────
   html.motion-ok is set by an inline script before paint when the
   user has not asked for reduced motion. GSAP then reveals these.  */
html.motion-ok [data-reveal],
html.motion-ok [data-hero] { visibility: hidden; }

/* ─── 3D card tilt ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.tilt-stage { perspective: 1100px; }
.tilt { transform-style: preserve-3d; will-change: transform; }
/* preserve-3d is not inherited: every layer between .tilt and a
   [data-depth] child must keep it (and must not blur/clip, which flattens) */
.tilt, .tilt * { transform-style: preserve-3d; }
.tilt [data-depth="1"] { transform: translateZ(18px); }
.tilt [data-depth="2"] { transform: translateZ(42px); }
.tilt [data-depth="3"] { transform: translateZ(64px); }


/* Accordion: animate grid rows, no height measuring */
.collapse-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows 260ms var(--ease-out);
}
.collapse-grid[data-open="true"] { grid-template-rows: 1fr; }
.collapse-grid > * { overflow: hidden; }

/* Hover affordances only for real pointers (touch fires false hovers) */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .lift { transition: transform 200ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 200ms var(--ease-out); }
  .lift:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
}
.press { transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-out); }
.press:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

/* ─── Reduced motion: gentler, not zero ────────────────────── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, ::before, ::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
  .collapse-grid { transition: none; }
}

/* ─── Apple HIG: material & contrast preferences ───────────── */
@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
  .glass, [class*="backdrop-blur"] { backdrop-filter: none !important; background-color: var(--warm-white) !important; }
}
@media (prefers-contrast: more) {
  :root { --muted: #4A443C; --border: #9C9282; }
  .glass { background-color: #fff !important; border-color: var(--navy) !important; }
}

/* Translucent chrome: light catching the top edge of the material */
.glass {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), 0 8px 32px -12px rgba(20, 38, 74, 0.2);
}
```

## File: app/layout.tsx

```tsx
import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
import Script from "next/script";
import { Outfit, Geist, Geist_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import Providers from "@/components/Providers";
import "./globals.css";
import { cfg } from "@/lib/config";

const outfit = Outfit({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-outfit",
  display: "swap",
});

const geist = Geist({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-geist",
  display: "swap",
});

const geistMono = Geist_Mono({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-geist-mono",
  display: "swap",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: cfg.seo.title,
  description: cfg.seo.description,
  keywords: cfg.seo.keywords,
  openGraph: {
    title: cfg.brand.name,
    description: cfg.brand.description,
    type: "website",
    locale: cfg.seo.locale,
  },
  robots: { index: true, follow: true },
};

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  themeColor: "#FAF6EF",
};

// Runs before first paint: lets CSS pre-hide elements GSAP will reveal,
// but only when the visitor hasn't asked for reduced motion.
const motionPref = `try{if(!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)document.documentElement.classList.add('motion-ok')}catch(e){}`;

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  return (
    <html
      lang="en"
      className={`${outfit.variable} ${geist.variable} ${geistMono.variable}`}
      suppressHydrationWarning
    >
      <body className="antialiased">
        <Script id="motion-pref" strategy="beforeInteractive">
          {motionPref}
        </Script>
        <Providers>{children}</Providers>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import Navbar from '@/components/Navbar';
```

## File: components/BookTestDialog.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { cfg } from '@/lib/config';
import { gsap, prefersReducedMotion, setScrollLocked } from '@/lib/gsap';
import { useBookTest } from '@/context/BookTestContext';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';

const d = cfg.bookTestDialog;

export default function BookTestDialog() {
  const { isOpen, closeDialog } = useBookTest();
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const panel = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = dialog.current;
    const p = panel.current;
    if (!el || !p) return;
    const reduce = prefersReducedMotion();

    if (isOpen && !el.open) {
      el.showModal();
      setScrollLocked(true);
      gsap.fromTo(el, { '--scrim': 0 }, { '--scrim': 1, duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.3, ease: 'ui-out' });
      gsap.fromTo(
        p,
        { autoAlpha: 0, y: reduce ? 0 : 24, scale: reduce ? 1 : 0.96, filter: reduce ? 'none' : 'blur(8px)' },
        { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)', duration: reduce ? 0.15 : 0.45, ease: 'ui-drawer', clearProps: 'filter' },
      );
    } else if (!isOpen && el.open) {
      // exit along the entry path
      gsap.to(el, { '--scrim': 0, duration: 0.2 });
      gsap.to(p, {
        autoAlpha: 0,
        y: reduce ? 0 : 24,
        scale: reduce ? 1 : 0.96,
        duration: reduce ? 0.1 : 0.22,
        ease: 'ui-out',
        onComplete: () => {
          el.close();
          setScrollLocked(false);
        },
      });
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  return (
    <dialog
      ref={dialog}
      aria-labelledby="book-title"
      onCancel={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault(); // let the exit animation run
        closeDialog();
      }}
      onClick={(e) => e.target === dialog.current && closeDialog()}
      className="m-0 h-full max-h-none w-full max-w-none bg-transparent p-4 backdrop:bg-transparent open:flex open:items-end open:justify-center sm:open:items-center"
      style={{ background: 'rgba(20,38,74, calc(var(--scrim, 0) * 0.5))' } as React.CSSProperties}
    >
      <div ref={panel} className="glass invisible w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white/90 opacity-0">
        <div className="relative bg-navy px-6 pb-6 pt-6">
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -right-12 -top-12 h-36 w-36 rounded-full bg-saffron/30 blur-2xl" />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={closeDialog}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="press absolute right-4 top-4 flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/12 text-white transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-white/22"
          >
            <Icon name="X" size={16} weight="bold" />
          </button>
          <h2 id="book-title" className="relative font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-white">
            {d.heading}
          </h2>
          <p className="relative mt-1 text-sm text-white/65">{d.subtext}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3 p-5">
          <a
            href={cfg.contact.phone.whatsapp}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            onClick={closeDialog}
            className="press group flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl bg-forest-pale p-4 transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-[#d8eedf]"
          >
            <span className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#25D366] text-white">
              <Icon name="WhatsApp" size={26} weight="fill" />
            </span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span className="block font-semibold text-forest">{d.whatsapp.label}</span>
              <span className="block text-sm text-forest/80">{d.whatsapp.description}</span>
              <span className="mt-1 inline-block rounded-full bg-white/70 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-forest">{d.whatsapp.subtext}</span>
            </span>
            <Icon name="ArrowRight" size={18} className="shrink-0 text-forest transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
          </a>

          <a
            href={cfg.contact.phone.primaryTel}
            onClick={closeDialog}
            className="press group flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl bg-navy-pale p-4 transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-[#dfe4f0]"
          >
            <span className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-navy text-white">
              <Icon name="Phone" size={24} />
            </span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span className="block font-semibold text-navy">{d.call.label}</span>
              <span className="block text-sm text-muted">{cfg.contact.phone.primary}</span>
              <span className="mt-1 inline-block rounded-full bg-white/70 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-navy">{d.call.subtext}</span>
            </span>
            <Icon name="ArrowRight" size={18} className="shrink-0 text-navy transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
          </a>
        </div>

        <p className="px-6 pb-5 text-center text-xs text-muted">Our team is available {cfg.hours.short}</p>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { cfg } from '@/lib/config';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';
import SectionHeading from '@/components/ui/SectionHeading';

const fq = cfg.faq;

export default function FAQ() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<number | null>(0);

  return (
    <section id="faq" data-station aria-label="Frequently asked questions" className="section-pad relative">
      <div className="station-grid mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div data-side="left">
          <SectionHeading heading={fq.heading} accent={fq.headingAccent} subtext={fq.subtext} stack={false} />

        <ul className="space-y-3">
          {fq.items.map((item, i) => {
            const isOpen = open === i;
            return (
              <li
                key={item.q}
                data-reveal
                className={`rounded-2xl bg-white transition-shadow duration-300 ${isOpen ? 'shadow-[0_24px_50px_-28px_rgba(194,65,12,0.5)]' : 'shadow-[0_10px_30px_-24px_rgba(20,38,74,0.45)]'}`}
              >
                <h3>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    id={`faq-q-${i}`}
                    onClick={() => setOpen(isOpen ? null : i)}
                    aria-expanded={isOpen}
                    aria-controls={`faq-a-${i}`}
                    className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-5 text-left"
                  >
                    <span className={`text-[15px] font-semibold leading-snug transition-colors duration-200 ${isOpen ? 'text-saffron' : 'text-charcoal'}`}>{item.q}</span>
                    <span
                      className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-[background-color,color,transform] duration-300 ease-out-strong ${
                        isOpen ? 'rotate-45 bg-saffron text-white' : 'bg-cream text-navy'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Icon name="Plus" size={15} weight="bold" />
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </h3>
                <div id={`faq-a-${i}`} role="region" aria-labelledby={`faq-q-${i}`} className="collapse-grid" data-open={isOpen}>
                  <div>
                    <p className="px-6 pb-6 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">{item.a}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>

          <p data-reveal className="mt-10 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-3 text-sm text-muted">
            <span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-charcoal">{fq.stillHaveQuestionsTitle}</span> {fq.stillHaveQuestionsSubtext}

              href={cfg.contact.phone.primaryTel}
              className="press inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-navy px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-navy-mid"
            >
              <Icon name="Phone" size={16} />
              {fq.callCtaLabel}
            </a>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## File: components/Hero.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { cfg } from '@/lib/config';
import { gsap, SplitText, useGSAP } from '@/lib/gsap';
import BookButton from '@/components/ui/BookButton';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';

const h = cfg.hero;
const fmt = (n: number) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-IN');

export default function Hero() {
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  useGSAP(
    () => {
      const mm = gsap.matchMedia();
      mm.add('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)', () => {
        // SplitText keeps an aria-label with the unsplit text for screen readers
        const split = SplitText.create('[data-split]', { type: 'lines,words', mask: 'lines', aria: 'auto' });
        const nums = gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('[data-count]');

        const tl = gsap.timeline({ delay: 0.5 });
        tl.set('[data-hero]', { autoAlpha: 1 })
          .from(split.words, { yPercent: 115, duration: 1.15, stagger: 0.06 })
          .from('[data-hero="sub"]', { y: 18, autoAlpha: 0, filter: 'blur(6px)', duration: 0.9, clearProps: 'filter' }, '-=0.75')
          .from('[data-hero="cta"] > *', { y: 16, autoAlpha: 0, stagger: 0.07, duration: 0.7 }, '-=0.6')
          .from('[data-hero="proof"]', { autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.7 }, '-=0.45')
          .from('[data-readout] > li', { y: 20, autoAlpha: 0, stagger: 0.08, duration: 0.8 }, '-=0.5')
          .add(() => {
            nums.forEach((el) => {
              const o = { v: 0 };
              gsap.to(o, { v: Number(el.dataset.count), duration: 1.8, ease: 'power3.out', onUpdate: () => void (el.textContent = fmt(o.v)) });
            });
          }, '<');
        return () => split.revert();
      });
      mm.add('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)', () => gsap.set('[data-hero]', { autoAlpha: 1 }));
    },
    { scope: root },
  );

  return (
    <section ref={root} id="top" data-station aria-label="Introduction" className="relative flex min-h-[100dvh] flex-col pt-24 lg:pt-28">
      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-7xl flex-1 items-center px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="station-grid w-full">
          <div data-side="left" className="max-w-3xl py-6">
            <h1 data-hero data-split className="font-display text-[2.5rem] font-semibold leading-[1.02] text-navy sm:text-[3.4rem] xl:text-[4rem]">
              <span className="sm:whitespace-nowrap">
                {h.headline.line1} {h.headline.line2}
              </span>
              <br />
              <span className="font-light text-saffron">
                {h.headline.line3} {h.headline.line4}
              </span>
            </h1>

            <p data-hero="sub" className="mt-6 max-w-[44ch] text-lg leading-relaxed text-muted">
              {h.subtext}
            </p>

            <div data-hero="cta" className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <BookButton>{h.ctaPrimary}</BookButton>
              <a
                href="#reports"
                className="press inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-navy/15 bg-white/70 px-6 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-navy transition-colors duration-200 hover:border-navy/35 hover:bg-white"
              >
                <Icon name="Download" size={18} />
                {h.ctaSecondary}
              </a>
            </div>

            <div data-hero="proof" className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-sm text-muted">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="flex text-amber">
                  {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((s) => (
                    <Icon key={s} name="Star" size={14} weight="fill" />
                  ))}
                </span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-charcoal">
                  {h.socialProof.rating}/{h.socialProof.ratingOutOf}
                </span>
              </span>
              <span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-charcoal">{h.socialProof.patientsServed}</span> {h.socialProof.patientsLabel}
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-forest">
                <Icon name="BadgeCheck" size={16} weight="fill" />
                {h.badge}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Lab readout */}
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 pb-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <ul data-readout className="grid grid-cols-2 border-t border-navy/10 lg:grid-cols-4">
          {cfg.trustMetrics.map((m, i) => (
            <li key={m.label} data-hero className={`flex items-baseline gap-3 py-4 ${i % 2 ? 'pl-5' : ''} ${i > 0 ? 'lg:border-l lg:border-navy/10 lg:pl-6' : ''}`}>
              <span className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold text-navy lg:text-4xl">
                <span data-count={m.end} className="tabular-nums">
                  {fmt(m.end)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-saffron">{m.suffix}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs leading-tight text-muted">
                <span className="block font-semibold text-charcoal">{m.label}</span>
                {m.sub}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## File: components/HomeCollection.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { cfg } from '@/lib/config';
import { gsap, useGSAP } from '@/lib/gsap';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';
import BookButton from '@/components/ui/BookButton';
import SectionHeading from '@/components/ui/SectionHeading';
import Tilt3D from '@/components/motion/Tilt3D';

const hc = cfg.homeCollection;

export default function HomeCollection() {
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  // The step line fills as you scroll through the steps (scrubbed)
  useGSAP(
    () => {
      gsap.matchMedia().add('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)', () => {
        gsap.fromTo(
          '[data-progress]',
          { scaleY: 0 },
          { scaleY: 1, ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { trigger: '[data-steps]', start: 'top 70%', end: 'bottom 55%', scrub: 0.6 } },
        );
      });
    },
    { scope: root },
  );

  return (
    <section ref={root} id="home-collection" data-station aria-label="Home sample collection" className="section-pad relative">
      <div className="station-grid mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div data-side="right">
          <SectionHeading heading={hc.heading} accent={hc.headingAccent} subtext={hc.subtext} />

          <ol data-steps className="relative space-y-8 pl-16">
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute bottom-2 left-[1.4rem] top-2 w-px bg-navy/10" />
            <span aria-hidden="true" data-progress className="absolute bottom-2 left-[1.4rem] top-2 w-px origin-top bg-saffron" />
            {hc.steps.map((step) => (
              <li key={step.number} data-reveal className="relative">
                <span className="absolute -left-16 top-0 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-navy text-white shadow-[0_8px_20px_-8px_rgba(20,38,74,0.6)]">
                  <Icon name={step.icon} fallback="Phone" size={20} />
                </span>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-saffron">Step {step.number}</p>
                <h3 className="mt-0.5 font-display text-xl font-semibold text-navy">{step.title}</h3>
                <p className="mt-1.5 max-w-[50ch] text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">{step.description}</p>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>

          <div data-reveal="scale" className="mt-14">
            <Tilt3D max={5} radius="1rem">
              <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-navy p-7 shadow-[0_30px_60px_-30px_rgba(20,38,74,0.7)] sm:p-9">
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -right-20 -top-20 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-saffron/25 blur-3xl" />
                <div className="relative grid gap-8 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] sm:items-end">
                  <div>
                    <p className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-xl font-semibold text-white">
                      <Icon name="Truck" size={24} className="text-amber" />
                      {hc.cardTitle}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-white/60">{hc.cardSubtitle}</p>
                    <ul className="mt-6 grid gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2">
                      {hc.features.map((item) => (
                        <li key={item} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm text-white/85">
                          <Icon name="CheckCircle2" size={17} weight="fill" className="shrink-0 text-[#5FD39B]" />
                          {item}
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                    <p className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-white/70">
                      <Icon name="Clock" size={17} className="text-amber" />
                      Available {cfg.hours.short}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <BookButton>{hc.ctaLabel}</BookButton>
                </div>
              </div>
            </Tilt3D>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## File: components/Navbar.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { cfg } from '@/lib/config';
import { gsap, ScrollTrigger, useGSAP, setScrollLocked } from '@/lib/gsap';
import { useBookTest } from '@/context/BookTestContext';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';

const logo = cfg.assets.logo;
const links = cfg.nav.links;

export default function Navbar() {
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const bar = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const hoverPill = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const overlay = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const menuTl = useRef<gsap.core.Timeline | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { openDialog } = useBookTest();

  const { contextSafe } = useGSAP(
    () => {
      // Intro: drop in from above
      gsap.from(bar.current, { yPercent: -140, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 1, delay: 0.2 });

      // Hide on scroll down, show on scroll up; denser glass after the hero
      ScrollTrigger.create({
        start: 0,
        end: 'max',
        onUpdate: (self) => {
          const y = self.scroll();
          if (menuTl.current?.isActive() || overlay.current?.dataset.open === 'true') return;
          gsap.to(bar.current, {
            yPercent: self.direction === 1 && y > 320 ? -160 : 0,
            duration: 0.45,
            ease: 'ui-out',
            overwrite: 'auto',
          });
        },
      });

      // Active section tracking
      links.forEach((l) => {
        const el = document.querySelector(l.href);
        if (!el) return;
        ScrollTrigger.create({
          trigger: el,
          start: 'top 45%',
          end: 'bottom 45%',
          onToggle: (self) => self.isActive && setActive(l.href),
          onLeaveBack: () => l.href === links[0].href && setActive(null),
        });
      });

      // Mobile menu timeline (built once, played/reversed)
      const items = overlay.current!.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-item]');
      menuTl.current = gsap
        .timeline({ paused: true })
        .set(overlay.current, { autoAlpha: 1 })
        .fromTo(overlay.current, { clipPath: 'inset(0 0 100% 0 round 0 0 32px 32px)' }, { clipPath: 'inset(0 0 0% 0 round 0 0 0px 0px)', duration: 0.55, ease: 'ui-drawer' })
        .fromTo(items, { yPercent: 110 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.6, stagger: 0.05 }, '-=0.3');
    },
    { scope: root },
  );

  // Event handlers: wrap in contextSafe at call time so tweens join the GSAP context
  const moveHoverPill = (target: HTMLElement | null) =>
    contextSafe(() => {
      const pill = hoverPill.current;
      if (!pill) return;
      if (!target) {
        gsap.to(pill, { autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.2 });
        return;
      }
      gsap.to(pill, {
        x: target.offsetLeft,
        width: target.offsetWidth,
        autoAlpha: 1,
        duration: 0.35,
        ease: 'ui-out',
      });
    })();

  const toggleMenu = (next: boolean) => {
    setOpen(next);
    overlay.current!.dataset.open = String(next);
    setScrollLocked(next);
    if (next) menuTl.current?.timeScale(1).play();
    else menuTl.current?.timeScale(1.6).reverse();
  };

  return (
    <header ref={root} className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-40">
      {/* scroll-edge fade: content dissolves before it slides under the floating bar */}
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-28 bg-linear-to-b from-cream via-cream/85 to-transparent sm:h-32" />
      <div className="px-3 pt-3 sm:px-6 sm:pt-5">
        <div
          ref={bar}
          className="glass relative mx-auto flex max-w-6xl items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-full py-2 pl-5 pr-2"
        >
          <a href="#top" aria-label={`${cfg.brand.name} home`} className="relative z-50 shrink-0">
            <Image
              src={logo.compactSrc}
              alt={cfg.brand.name}
              width={logo.compactWidth}
              height={logo.compactHeight}
              priority
              unoptimized
              className="h-9 w-auto sm:h-10"
            />
          </a>

          {/* Desktop links with travelling hover pill */}
          <nav aria-label="Primary" className="relative hidden lg:block" onMouseLeave={() => moveHoverPill(null)}>
            <span ref={hoverPill} aria-hidden="true" className="invisible absolute left-0 top-0 h-full rounded-full bg-navy-pale opacity-0" />
            <ul className="relative flex items-center">
              {links.map((l) => (
                <li key={l.href}>
                  <a
                    href={l.href}
                    onMouseEnter={(e) => moveHoverPill(e.currentTarget)}
                    onFocus={(e) => moveHoverPill(e.currentTarget)}
                    aria-current={active === l.href ? 'true' : undefined}
                    className="relative block rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-charcoal/80 transition-colors duration-200 hover:text-navy aria-[current]:text-navy"
                  >
                    {l.label}
                    <span
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      className={`absolute bottom-1 left-1/2 h-1 w-1 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-saffron transition-[opacity,transform] duration-300 ease-out-strong ${
                        active === l.href ? 'scale-100 opacity-100' : 'scale-0 opacity-0'
                      }`}
                    />
                  </a>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </nav>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <a
              href={cfg.contact.phone.primaryTel}
              aria-label={`Call ${cfg.contact.phone.primary}`}
              className="press hidden h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-navy transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-navy-pale md:flex"
            >
              <Icon name="Phone" size={18} />
              <span className="font-mono text-[13px]">{cfg.contact.phone.primary}</span>
            </a>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={openDialog}
              className="press group hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-saffron py-1.5 pl-5 pr-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-saffron-deep sm:inline-flex"
            >
              {cfg.nav.ctaLabel}
              <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15 transition-transform duration-200 ease-out-strong group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:-translate-y-px">
                <Icon name="ArrowUpRight" size={15} weight="bold" />
              </span>
            </button>

            {/* Hamburger → X morph */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => toggleMenu(!open)}
              aria-label={open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
              aria-expanded={open}
              aria-controls="mobile-menu"
              className="press relative z-50 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-navy text-white lg:hidden"
            >
              <span className="relative block h-3 w-5">
                <span className={`absolute left-0 h-[1.5px] w-5 rounded bg-current transition-transform duration-300 ease-out-strong ${open ? 'top-1/2 rotate-45' : 'top-0'}`} />
                <span className={`absolute left-0 h-[1.5px] w-5 rounded bg-current transition-transform duration-300 ease-out-strong ${open ? 'top-1/2 -rotate-45' : 'top-full'}`} />
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile overlay */}
      <div
        ref={overlay}
        id="mobile-menu"
        data-open="false"
        className="invisible fixed inset-0 z-40 flex flex-col bg-cream/95 px-6 pb-10 pt-28 opacity-0 backdrop-blur-2xl lg:hidden"
      >
        <nav aria-label="Mobile">
          <ul className="space-y-1">
            {links.map((l, i) => (
              <li key={l.href} className="overflow-hidden">
                <a
                  data-menu-item
                  href={l.href}
                  onClick={() => toggleMenu(false)}
                  className="flex items-baseline gap-4 py-2 font-display text-4xl font-medium text-navy"
                >
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs text-saffron">0{i + 1}</span>
                  {l.label}
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </nav>
        <div className="mt-auto space-y-3 overflow-hidden">
          <div data-menu-item>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                toggleMenu(false);
                openDialog();
              }}
              className="press w-full rounded-full bg-saffron py-4 text-base font-semibold text-white"
            >
              {cfg.nav.ctaLabel}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div data-menu-item>
            <a
              href={cfg.contact.phone.primaryTel}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-line py-4 font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-navy"
            >
              <Icon name="Phone" size={18} />
              {cfg.contact.phone.primary}
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
```

## File: components/ReportDownload.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { cfg } from '@/lib/config';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';
import SectionHeading from '@/components/ui/SectionHeading';
import Tilt3D from '@/components/motion/Tilt3D';

const rc = cfg.hero.reportCard;

export default function ReportDownload() {
  const [reportId, setReportId] = useState('');
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState('');
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);

  const idOk = reportId.trim().length >= 4;
  const mobileOk = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(mobile);

  const onSubmit = (e: React.SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTouched(true);
    if (idOk && mobileOk) setSent(true);
  };

  return (
    <section id="reports" data-station aria-label="Download your report" className="section-pad relative">
      <div className="station-grid mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div data-side="right">
          <SectionHeading
            heading="Your reports."
            accent="Always ready."
            subtext="Open your reports securely, any time. Each one is signed by our pathologist and ready to share with your doctor."
          />

          <div className="grid items-start gap-6 md:grid-cols-[1.05fr_1fr]">
            {/* Report preview — 3D */}
            <div data-reveal="left">
              <Tilt3D max={9} radius="1rem">
                <article aria-label="Sample report" className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-[0_40px_70px_-36px_rgba(20,38,74,0.55)]">
                  <header data-depth="1" className="flex items-center justify-between bg-navy px-5 py-4">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-white/55">{rc.title}</p>
                      <p className="font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">{rc.testName}</p>
                      <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-white/50">ID {rc.reportId}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-forest/30 text-[#5FD39B]">
                      <Icon name="BadgeCheck" size={22} weight="fill" />
                    </span>
                  </header>
                  <table className="w-full text-left">
                    <caption className="sr-only">Sample lipid profile values</caption>
                    <tbody>
                      {rc.metrics.map((m) => (
                        <tr key={m.name} className="border-b border-navy/5 last:border-0">
                          <th scope="row" className="px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-charcoal">
                            {m.name}
                            <span className="block font-mono text-[10px] font-normal text-muted">ref {m.ref}</span>
                          </th>
                          <td className="px-5 py-2.5 text-right">
                            <span className="block font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-navy">{m.value}</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-forest">Normal</span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                  <footer className="flex items-center justify-between bg-cream px-5 py-3 text-[11px]">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-forest">
                      <Icon name="Shield" size={14} /> {rc.footerVerified}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-muted">{rc.footerTurnaround}</span>
                  </footer>
                </article>
              </Tilt3D>
            </div>

            {/* Access form */}
            <div data-reveal="right" className="rounded-2xl bg-navy p-6 shadow-[0_30px_60px_-30px_rgba(20,38,74,0.7)] sm:p-7">
              {sent ? (
                <div role="status" className="py-6 text-center">
                  <Icon name="CheckCircle2" size={40} weight="fill" className="mx-auto text-[#5FD39B]" />
                  <p className="mt-3 font-display text-xl font-semibold text-white">OTP sent</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-white/65">
                    Check the SMS on +91 {mobile} to open report {reportId}.
                  </p>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setSent(false)} className="mt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-amber underline">
                    Use a different number
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
                  <Field
                    id="report-id"
                    label="Patient or report ID"
                    hint="Printed on your receipt"
                    value={reportId}
                    onChange={setReportId}
                    placeholder="MG-2024-08821"
                    error={touched && !idOk ? 'Enter the ID printed on your receipt.' : undefined}
                  />
                  <Field
                    id="mobile"
                    label="Registered mobile"
                    type="tel"
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    autoComplete="tel-national"
                    value={mobile}
                    onChange={(v) => setMobile(v.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 10))}
                    placeholder="98765 43210"
                    error={touched && !mobileOk ? 'Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number.' : undefined}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="press flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-saffron py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-saffron-deep"
                  >
                    <Icon name="Download" size={18} />
                    Get my report
                  </button>
                  <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-white/55">
                    <Icon name="Lock" size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                    We send a one-time password to your registered mobile. Only you can open the report.
                  </p>
                </form>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Field({
  id,
  label,
  hint,
  value,
  onChange,
  error,
  ...rest
}: {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  error?: string;
} & Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'onChange' | 'value' | 'id'>) {
  const describedBy = [hint && `${id}-hint`, error && `${id}-err`].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined;
  return (
    <div>
      <label htmlFor={id} className="flex items-baseline justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-white/80">
        {label}
        {hint && (
          <span id={`${id}-hint`} className="font-normal text-white/45">
            {hint}
          </span>
        )}
      </label>
      <input
        id={id}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        aria-invalid={!!error}
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        className="mt-1.5 w-full rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/7 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white outline-none transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-200 placeholder:text-white/35 focus:border-amber focus:shadow-[0_0_0_4px_rgba(233,162,59,0.18)] aria-[invalid=true]:border-[#F59E8B]"
        {...rest}
      />
      {error && (
        <p id={`${id}-err`} className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-[#F8B4A6]">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## File: components/ServicesGrid.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { cfg } from '@/lib/config';
import { scrollState } from '@/lib/scroll-store';
import { useBookTest } from '@/context/BookTestContext';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';
import SectionHeading from '@/components/ui/SectionHeading';

const s = cfg.services;

/**
 * Editorial service index. Hovering/focusing a row lifts the matching
 * test tube in the 3D rack on the left (scrollState.hoverService).
 */
export default function ServicesGrid() {
  const { openDialog } = useBookTest();
  const focus = (i: number) => () => void (scrollState.hoverService = i);
  const blur = () => void (scrollState.hoverService = -1);

  return (
    <section id="services" data-station aria-label="Our services" className="section-pad relative">
      <div className="station-grid mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div data-side="right">
          <SectionHeading heading={s.heading} accent={s.headingAccent} subtext={s.subtext} />

          <ul className="border-t border-navy/10" onMouseLeave={blur}>
            {s.items.map((service, i) => (
              <li key={service.title} data-reveal className="border-b border-navy/10">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={openDialog}
                  onMouseEnter={focus(i)}
                  onFocus={focus(i)}
                  onBlur={blur}
                  className="group relative grid w-full grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto] items-center gap-5 py-6 text-left"
                >
                  <span
                    className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl transition-transform duration-300 ease-out-strong group-hover:-rotate-6 group-hover:scale-105"
                    style={{ background: service.iconBg, color: service.iconColor }}
                  >
                    <Icon name={service.icon} size={26} />
                  </span>
                  <span>
                    <span className="block font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-navy transition-colors duration-200 group-hover:text-saffron">
                      {service.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="mt-1 block max-w-[52ch] text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">{service.description}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-navy/15 text-navy transition-[background-color,color,border-color,transform] duration-300 ease-out-strong group-hover:-rotate-45 group-hover:border-saffron group-hover:bg-saffron group-hover:text-white">
                    <Icon name="ArrowRight" size={16} weight="bold" />
                    <span className="sr-only">Book {service.title}</span>
                  </span>
                  {/* hover rule grows from the left */}
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -bottom-px left-0 h-px w-full origin-left scale-x-0 bg-saffron transition-transform duration-500 ease-out-strong group-hover:scale-x-100" />
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## File: components/TestCategories.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { cfg } from '@/lib/config';
import { gsap, ScrollTrigger, useGSAP } from '@/lib/gsap';
import { scrollState } from '@/lib/scroll-store';
import { useBookTest } from '@/context/BookTestContext';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';
import SectionHeading from '@/components/ui/SectionHeading';

const tc = cfg.testCatalogue;

export default function TestCategories() {
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { openDialog } = useBookTest();
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const results = useMemo(() => {
    if (q) {
      return tc.allTests.flatMap((g) => g.tests.filter((t) => t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)).map((t) => ({ ...t, category: g.category })));
    }
    if (active) {
      const g = tc.allTests.find((x) => x.category === active);
      return (g?.tests ?? []).map((t) => ({ ...t, category: active }));
    }
    return null;
  }, [q, active]);

  const catColor = (label: string) => tc.categories.find((c) => c.label === label)?.color ?? 'var(--navy)';

  // Re-run a short stagger whenever the visible list changes, then re-measure triggers below
  useGSAP(
    () => {
      const rows = list.current?.querySelectorAll('[data-row]');
      if (rows?.length && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
        gsap.fromTo(rows, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 14 }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.45, stagger: 0.03, overwrite: true });
      }
      ScrollTrigger.refresh();
    },
    { scope: root, dependencies: [active, q], revertOnUpdate: false },
  );

  const choose = (label: string) => {
    setQuery('');
    setExpanded(null);
    setActive((cur) => {
      const next = cur === label ? null : label;
      scrollState.bodyRegion = next; // body scan focuses the organ for this category
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <section ref={root} id="test-categories" data-station aria-label="Test categories" className="section-pad relative">
      <div className="station-grid mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div data-side="left">
        <SectionHeading heading={tc.heading} accent={tc.headingAccent} stack={false} />

        <div data-reveal className="mb-10 flex flex-col gap-5">
          {/* Category chips */}
          <div role="group" aria-label="Filter by category" className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {tc.categories.map((cat) => {
              const on = active === cat.label && !q;
              return (
                <button
                  key={cat.label}
                  type="button"
                  aria-pressed={on}
                  onClick={() => choose(cat.label)}
                  className="press flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border py-1.5 pl-1.5 pr-4 text-sm font-medium transition-colors duration-200"
                  style={{
                    background: on ? cat.color : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)',
                    borderColor: on ? cat.color : 'var(--border)',
                    color: on ? '#fff' : 'var(--charcoal)',
                  }}
                >
                  <span
                    className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full"
                    style={{ background: on ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' : cat.bg, color: on ? '#fff' : cat.color }}
                  >
                    <Icon name={cat.icon} size={15} />
                  </span>
                  {cat.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Search */}
          <label className="relative block w-full sm:max-w-sm">
            <span className="sr-only">Search tests</span>
            <Icon name="Microscope" size={18} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted" />
            <input
              type="search"
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setQuery(e.target.value);
                setExpanded(null);
                scrollState.bodyRegion = null;
              }}
              placeholder="Search a test, e.g. HbA1c"
              className="w-full rounded-full border border-line bg-white/85 py-3 pl-11 pr-4 text-sm text-charcoal outline-none transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-200 placeholder:text-muted/70 focus:border-saffron focus:shadow-[0_0_0_4px_rgba(194,65,12,0.12)]"
            />
          </label>
        </div>

        <div ref={list} aria-live="polite">
          {results === null ? (
            <>
              <h3 className="mb-5 font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-navy">{tc.popularTestsHeading}</h3>
              <ul className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {tc.popularTests.map((t) => (
                  <li key={t.name} data-row className="lift flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-[0_14px_34px_-22px_rgba(20,38,74,0.45)]">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="mb-1.5 inline-block rounded-full bg-saffron-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-saffron">{t.tag}</span>
                      <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal">{t.name}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted">
                        <Icon name="Clock" size={12} /> {t.turnaround}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
                      <p className="font-mono text-base font-semibold text-navy">{t.price}</p>
                      <button type="button" onClick={openDialog} className="press mt-1 rounded-full bg-navy-pale px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-navy transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-navy hover:text-white">
                        {tc.bookLabel}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <h3 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-navy">
                  {q ? `Results for “${query.trim()}”` : `${tc.allTestsHeading}: ${active}`}
                  <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-sm font-normal text-muted">{results.length}</span>
                </h3>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActive(null);
                    setQuery('');
                    scrollState.bodyRegion = null;
                  }}
                  className="press inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-navy-pale px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-navy"
                >
                  <Icon name="ArrowLeft" size={15} /> {tc.backLabel}
                </button>
              </div>

              {results.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted shadow-[0_14px_34px_-22px_rgba(20,38,74,0.45)]">
                  No test matches that name. Call us and we&apos;ll help you find it.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="space-y-2">
                  {results.map((t) => {
                    const id = `${t.category}-${t.name}`;
                    const open = expanded === id;
                    const color = catColor(t.category);
                    return (
                      <li
                        key={id}
                        data-row
                        className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white/95 ring-1 transition-shadow duration-200"
                        style={{ ['--tw-ring-color' as string]: open ? color : 'rgba(20,38,74,0.06)' }}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-4">
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal">{t.name}</p>
                            <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted">
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Icon name="Clock" size={12} /> {t.turnaround}
                              </span>
                              {t.preparation && <span className="rounded-full bg-cream px-2 py-0.5">{t.preparation}</span>}
                              {q && (
                                <span className="rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-medium" style={{ color, background: 'var(--cream)' }}>
                                  {t.category}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <p className="shrink-0 font-mono text-base font-semibold text-navy">{t.price}</p>
                          <button type="button" onClick={openDialog} className="press shrink-0 rounded-full bg-navy-pale px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-navy transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-navy hover:text-white">
                            {tc.bookLabel}
                          </button>
                          {t.parameters && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setExpanded(open ? null : id)}
                              aria-expanded={open}
                              aria-label={open ? 'Hide parameters' : 'Show parameters'}
                              className="press flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-colors duration-200"
                              style={{ background: open ? color : 'var(--cream)', color: open ? '#fff' : 'var(--muted)' }}
                            >
                              <Icon name="CaretDown" size={14} weight="bold" className={`transition-transform duration-200 ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        {t.parameters && (
                          <div className="collapse-grid" data-open={open}>
                            <div>
                              <div className="border-t border-dashed px-4 pb-4 pt-3" style={{ borderColor: `${color}55` }}>
                                <p className="mb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color }}>
                                  {tc.parametersLabel}
                                </p>
                                <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted">{t.parameters}</p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </li>
                    );
                  })}
                </ul>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## File: components/motion/SmoothScroll.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { gsap, ScrollTrigger, ScrollSmoother, useGSAP, scrollToTarget } from '@/lib/gsap';
import { scrollState } from '@/lib/scroll-store';

/**
 * Page-level motion root.
 *  - ScrollSmoother (skipped for reduced motion) with data-speed/data-lag effects
 *  - [data-reveal]  → batched ScrollTrigger fade-up (values: up | fade | scale | left | right)
 *  - [data-pin]     → pinned inside its parent on ≥1024px (replaces CSS sticky,
 *                     which can't work inside a transformed smoother)
 *  - in-page #anchor links → smoother.scrollTo / ScrollToPlugin
 *  - page progress  → scrollState for the 3D scene camera
 */
export default function SmoothScroll({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const wrapper = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const content = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useGSAP(
    () => {
      const mm = gsap.matchMedia();

      mm.add(
        {
          motion: '(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)',
          reduce: '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)',
          desktop: '(min-width: 1024px)',
        },
        (ctx) => {
          const { motion, desktop } = ctx.conditions as Record<string, boolean>;

          if (motion) {
            ScrollSmoother.create({
              wrapper: wrapper.current!,
              content: content.current!,
              smooth: 1.1,
              smoothTouch: 0.1,
              effects: true,
            });
          }

          // Feed the 3D scene
          ScrollTrigger.create({
            start: 0,
            end: 'max',
            onUpdate: (self) => {
              scrollState.progress = self.progress;
              scrollState.velocity = self.getVelocity();
            },
          });

          // Stations: continuous index for the 3D camera. The hero runs 0 → 0.5,
          // every later section runs i-0.5 → i+0.5 while its centre passes the
          // viewport centre, so the object arrives exactly with its content.
          gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('[data-station]').forEach((el, i) => {
            ScrollTrigger.create({
              trigger: el,
              start: i === 0 ? 'top top' : 'top center',
              end: 'bottom center',
              onUpdate: (self) => {
                scrollState.station = i === 0 ? self.progress * 0.5 : i - 0.5 + self.progress;
              },
            });
          });

          // Reveals
          const targets = gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('[data-reveal]');
          if (!motion) {
            gsap.set(targets, { autoAlpha: 1 });
          } else {
            const from = (el: HTMLElement): gsap.TweenVars => {
              switch (el.dataset.reveal) {
                case 'fade': return { autoAlpha: 0 };
                case 'scale': return { autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.96 };
                case 'left': return { autoAlpha: 0, x: -40 };
                case 'right': return { autoAlpha: 0, x: 40 };
                default: return { autoAlpha: 0, y: 40 };
              }
            };
            targets.forEach((el) => gsap.set(el, from(el)));
            ScrollTrigger.batch(targets, {
              start: 'top 90%',
              once: true,
              onEnter: (batch) =>
                gsap.to(batch, {
                  autoAlpha: 1,
                  x: 0,
                  y: 0,
                  scale: 1,
                  duration: 0.9,
                  stagger: 0.06,
                  overwrite: true,
                  clearProps: 'transform',
                }),
            });
          }

          // Desktop pins
          if (desktop) {
            gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('[data-pin]').forEach((el) => {
              const parent = el.parentElement!;
              ScrollTrigger.create({
                trigger: el,
                start: 'top 128px',
                end: () => `+=${Math.max(0, parent.offsetHeight - el.offsetHeight)}`,
                pin: true,
                pinSpacing: false,
                invalidateOnRefresh: true,
              });
            });
          }
        },
      );

      // Anchor links
      const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
        const a = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLAnchorElement>('a[href^="#"]');
        if (!a) return;
        const id = a.getAttribute('href')!;
        const target = id.length > 1 ? document.querySelector(id) : null;
        if (!target) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        scrollToTarget(target);
        history.replaceState(null, '', id);
      };
      document.addEventListener('click', onClick);

      // Web fonts change line heights → re-measure triggers once they land
      document.fonts?.ready.then(() => ScrollTrigger.refresh());

      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
        mm.revert();
      };
    },
    { scope: wrapper },
  );

  return (
    <div id="smooth-wrapper" ref={wrapper}>
      <div id="smooth-content" ref={content}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## File: components/motion/Tilt3D.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { gsap, useGSAP, hasFinePointer, prefersReducedMotion } from '@/lib/gsap';

interface Props {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  /** Max tilt in degrees */
  max?: number;
  as?: 'div' | 'article' | 'li';
  /** Corner radius of the glare clip — match the card */
  radius?: string;
}

/**
 * 3D pointer tilt. Children marked data-depth="1|2|3" sit on raised
 * planes (translateZ in CSS), so the card reads as layered hardware.
 * Only runs for fine pointers without reduced motion.
 */
export default function Tilt3D({ children, className = '', style, max = 7, as: Tag = 'div', radius = '2rem' }: Props) {
  const stage = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const card = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const glare = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useGSAP(
    (_, contextSafe) => {
      if (!hasFinePointer() || prefersReducedMotion() || !card.current || !contextSafe) return;
      const el = card.current;
      const rx = gsap.quickTo(el, 'rotationX', { duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3' });
      const ry = gsap.quickTo(el, 'rotationY', { duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3' });
      const gx = gsap.quickTo(glare.current, 'xPercent', { duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3' });
      const gy = gsap.quickTo(glare.current, 'yPercent', { duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3' });

      const move = contextSafe((e: PointerEvent) => {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const px = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5;
        const py = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5;
        ry(px * max * 2);
        rx(-py * max * 2);
        gx(px * 60);
        gy(py * 60);
      });
      const enter = contextSafe(() => gsap.to(glare.current, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.3 }));
      const leave = contextSafe(() => {
        rx(0);
        ry(0);
        gsap.to(glare.current, { autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.4 });
      });

      el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
      el.addEventListener('pointerenter', enter);
      el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);
      return () => {
        el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
        el.removeEventListener('pointerenter', enter);
        el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);
      };
    },
    { scope: stage },
  );

  return (
    <div ref={stage} className="tilt-stage h-full">
      <Tag ref={card as never} className={`tilt relative h-full ${className}`} style={style}>
        {children}
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden" style={{ borderRadius: radius }}>
          <div
            ref={glare}
            className="invisible absolute -inset-1/2 opacity-0"
            style={{
              background: 'radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255,255,255,0.6), transparent 45%)',
              mixBlendMode: 'soft-light',
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </Tag>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## File: components/three/BackgroundScene.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

const REDUCE = '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)';
const subscribe = (cb: () => void) => {
  const mq = window.matchMedia(REDUCE);
  mq.addEventListener('change', cb);
  return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', cb);
};

/**
 * Fixed full-viewport 3D background. The three.js engine is imported on
 * idle (never competes with LCP), fades in once it has rendered, and is a
 * single static frame for reduced-motion visitors.
 */
export default function BackgroundScene() {
  const canvas = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const reduced = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => window.matchMedia(REDUCE).matches, () => false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let dispose: (() => void) | undefined;
    let cancelled = false;
    const idle = window.requestIdleCallback ?? ((cb: () => void) => window.setTimeout(cb, 300));
    const cancelIdle = window.cancelIdleCallback ?? window.clearTimeout;

    const id = idle(async () => {
      const { createLabScene } = await import('./engine');
      if (cancelled || !canvas.current) return;
      try {
        dispose = createLabScene(canvas.current, { animate: !reduced, onReady: () => setReady(true) }).dispose;
      } catch {
        // No WebGL: the page is complete without the background
      }
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      cancelIdle(id as number);
      dispose?.();
    };
  }, [reduced]);

  return (
    <div
      aria-hidden="true"
      data-ready={ready || undefined}
      className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-0 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-[1400ms] ease-out-strong data-[ready]:opacity-40 lg:data-[ready]:opacity-100"
    >
      <canvas ref={canvas} className="block h-full w-full" />
    </div>
  );
}
```
