## File: components/three/engine.ts

```ts
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoomEnvironment } from 'three/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
import { gsap } from '@/lib/gsap';
import { scrollState } from '@/lib/scroll-store';
import { bloodCells, clearModelCache, dnaHelix, flask, holoHuman, microscope, molecule, particles, pills, rack, sampleKit, testTubes, whiteCell, type LabObject } from './objects';

const { damp } = THREE.MathUtils;

/** World-space distance between stations along -Y */
export const STEP = 8;
const FOV = 35;
const CAM_Z = 11;

interface Ctx {
  animate: boolean;
  loader: GLTFLoader;
  /** half the visible world width at z=0 */
  halfW: number;
}

interface Station {
  /** which side the object occupies; the section puts its copy on the other side */
  side: -1 | 0 | 1;
  scale: number;
  tilt?: THREE.Vector3Tuple;
  y?: number;
  build: (c: Ctx) => LabObject[];
}

const at = (o: LabObject, x: number, y: number, z: number): LabObject => (o.object.position.set(x, y, z), o);

/**
 * One entry per [data-station] section, in page order (see app/page.tsx).
 * Every lab object is a real model file (public/models/lab, credits in
 * lib/model-credits.ts); only the body scan shader and particles are authored.
 */
const STATIONS: Station[] = [
  /* 0 hero      */ { side: 1, scale: 0.85, tilt: [0.1, 0, -0.28], y: -0.3, build: (c) => [dnaHelix(c.loader, { animate: c.animate }), at(bloodCells(c.loader, { count: 4, spread: 1.8, cellSize: 0.62, animate: c.animate }), -2.1, -1.7, -0.6)] },
  /* 1 services  */ { side: -1, scale: 1.2, tilt: [0.22, 0.45, 0], build: (c) => [testTubes(c.loader)] },
  /* 2 why       */ { side: 1, scale: 1.15, tilt: [0.1, -0.5, 0], y: -0.2, build: (c) => [microscope(c.loader, c.animate)] },
  /* 3 home      */ { side: -1, scale: 1.05, tilt: [0.1, 0.3, 0], build: (c) => [sampleKit(c.loader, c.animate)] },
  /* 4 tests     */ { side: 1, scale: 1.05, tilt: [0.05, -0.3, 0], y: -1.75, build: (c) => [holoHuman(c.loader, c.animate)] },
  /* 5 reports   */ { side: -1, scale: 1.1, tilt: [0.25, 0.6, 0], build: (c) => [rack(c.loader)] },
  /* 6 reviews   */ { side: 1, scale: 1, build: (c) => [molecule(c.loader, c.animate)] },
  /* 7 doctors   */ { side: -1, scale: 1, build: (c) => [whiteCell(c.loader, c.animate), at(bloodCells(c.loader, { count: 4, spread: 2, cellSize: 0.6, animate: c.animate, seed: 21 }), -1.8, -1.2, -0.4)] },
  /* 8 faq       */ { side: 1, scale: 1, build: (c) => [pills(c.loader, { animate: c.animate }), at(flask(c.loader, c.animate), 0.3, -0.2, -1)] },
  /* 9 final cta */ { side: 0, scale: 1, build: (c) => [at(bloodCells(c.loader, { count: 6, spread: 1.6, animate: c.animate, seed: 5 }), -c.halfW * 0.95, 1.5, -1.8), at(bloodCells(c.loader, { count: 6, spread: 1.6, animate: c.animate, seed: 9 }), c.halfW * 0.95, -1.6, -1.8)] },
];

export interface LabScene {
  dispose: () => void;
}

/**
 * Vanilla three.js lab scene (no React renderer): THREE.Timer clock,
 * renderer.setAnimationLoop (display refresh rate: 60/120/144 Hz), dt-based
 * damping everywhere, adaptive pixel ratio, full disposal.
 */
export function createLabScene(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, { animate, onReady }: { animate: boolean; onReady: () => void }): LabScene {
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
  renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
  renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  let dprCap = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 1.75);
  renderer.setPixelRatio(dprCap);

  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  scene.fog = new THREE.Fog('#FAF6EF', 10, 24);
  const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer);
  const room = new RoomEnvironment();
  scene.environment = pmrem.fromScene(room, 0.04).texture;
  room.dispose();
  pmrem.dispose();
  scene.environmentIntensity = 0.9;

  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight('#ffffff', 0.45));
  scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight('#ffffff', '#E9D8C0', 0.5));
  const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#FFF4E6', 1.6);
  key.position.set(5, 8, 6);
  const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#E9A23B', 0.7);
  rim.position.set(-6, -2, -4);
  scene.add(key, rim);

  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(FOV, 1, 0.1, 60);
  camera.position.set(0, 0, CAM_Z);

  const loader = new GLTFLoader();
  const updates: NonNullable<LabObject['update']>[] = [];
  const add = (o: LabObject, parent: THREE.Object3D) => {
    parent.add(o.object);
    if (o.update) updates.push(o.update);
  };

  const halfWidth = () => Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(FOV / 2)) * CAM_Z * camera.aspect;
  const size = () => {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    const h = window.innerHeight;
    renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
    camera.aspect = w / h;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  };
  size();

  add(particles(animate ? 520 : 260, STATIONS.length * STEP + 8), scene);

  const ctx: Ctx = { animate, loader, halfW: halfWidth() };
  const groups = STATIONS.map((s, i) => {
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    if (s.tilt) g.rotation.set(...s.tilt);
    s.build(ctx).forEach((o) => add(o, g));
    scene.add(g);
    return { g, s, i, baseRotY: s.tilt?.[1] ?? 0 };
  });

  const layout = () => {
    const halfW = halfWidth();
    const wide = halfW * 2 > 7.5;
    for (const { g, s, i } of groups) {
      // Phones: objects ride the right edge, further back and smaller (canvas is also faded in CSS)
      g.position.set(wide ? s.side * Math.min(halfW * 0.54, 4.4) : halfW * 0.78, -i * STEP + (s.y ?? 0), wide ? 0 : -3);
      g.userData.base = s.scale * (wide ? 1 : 0.5);
      g.scale.setScalar(g.userData.base * 0.82);
    }
  };
  layout();

  // Pointer parallax for fine pointers only
  const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;
  const pointer = { x: 0 };
  const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => (pointer.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1);
  if (fine) window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointer, { passive: true });

  const onResize = () => {
    size();
    layout();
    if (!animate) render();
  };
  window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

  const timer = new THREE.Timer();
  timer.connect(document); // Page Visibility API: no giant delta after a hidden tab

  // Adaptive resolution: drop pixel ratio if frames run slow for ~1.5s
  let slow = 0;
  const adapt = (dt: number) => {
    slow = dt > 1 / 40 ? slow + dt : Math.max(0, slow - dt * 0.5);
    if (slow > 1.5 && dprCap > 1) {
      dprCap = Math.max(1, dprCap - 0.5);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(dprCap);
      slow = 0;
    }
  };

  const render = () => renderer.render(scene, camera);

  const frame = (time: number) => {
    timer.update(time);
    const dt = Math.min(timer.getDelta(), 0.1);
    const t = timer.getElapsed();

    camera.position.y = damp(camera.position.y, -scrollState.station * STEP, 3.2, dt);
    if (fine) camera.position.x = damp(camera.position.x, pointer.x * 0.45, 2, dt);
    camera.lookAt(camera.position.x * 0.4, camera.position.y, 0);

    for (const { g, i, baseRotY } of groups) {
      const d = Math.abs(scrollState.station - i);
      g.visible = d < 1.4;
      if (!g.visible) continue;
      const active = 1 - Math.min(d, 1);
      g.scale.setScalar(damp(g.scale.x, g.userData.base * (0.82 + active * 0.18), 4, dt));
      g.rotation.y = damp(g.rotation.y, baseRotY + (scrollState.station - i) * 0.6, 3, dt);
    }
    for (const u of updates) u(t, dt);
    adapt(dt);
    render();
  };

  let intro: gsap.core.Tween | null = null;
  if (animate) {
    intro = gsap.fromTo(camera.position, { z: 17, y: 2.5 }, { z: CAM_Z, y: 0, duration: 2.4, ease: 'ui-out', delay: 0.2 });
    renderer.setAnimationLoop(frame);
  } else {
    // Reduced motion: one static frame of the hero station, no moving background
    camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
    groups.forEach(({ g, i }) => (g.visible = i === 0));
    render();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(onReady);

  return {
    dispose() {
      intro?.kill();
      renderer.setAnimationLoop(null);
      timer.dispose();
      window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointer);
      const seen = new Set<unknown>();
      scene.traverse((o) => {
        const m = o as THREE.Mesh;
        if (m.geometry && !seen.has(m.geometry)) {
          seen.add(m.geometry);
          m.geometry.dispose();
        }
        const mats = Array.isArray(m.material) ? m.material : m.material ? [m.material] : [];
        for (const mat of mats) {
          if (seen.has(mat)) continue;
          seen.add(mat);
          for (const v of Object.values(mat)) if (v instanceof THREE.Texture) v.dispose();
          mat.dispose();
        }
      });
      scene.environment?.dispose();
      clearModelCache();
      renderer.dispose();
    },
  };
}
```

## File: components/three/materials.ts

```ts
import * as THREE from 'three';

/** Brand palette in linear-ready THREE.Color form */
export const C = {
  saffron: new THREE.Color('#C2410C'),
  marigold: new THREE.Color('#E9A23B'),
  ink: new THREE.Color('#14264A'),
  inkMid: new THREE.Color('#22396B'),
  tulsi: new THREE.Color('#1E7A4F'),
  cream: new THREE.Color('#FAF6EF'),
  enamel: new THREE.Color('#F1EBE0'),
  blood: new THREE.Color('#A8321A'),
};

let cache: ReturnType<typeof build> | null = null;

function build() {
  const glass = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
    color: '#ffffff',
    roughness: 0.06,
    metalness: 0,
    clearcoat: 1,
    clearcoatRoughness: 0.05,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.32,
    envMapIntensity: 1.4,
    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
    depthWrite: false,
  });

  return {
    glass,
    inkMetal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.ink, metalness: 0.55, roughness: 0.32 }),
    enamel: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.enamel, metalness: 0.05, roughness: 0.45 }),
    chrome: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#D7DCE4', metalness: 1, roughness: 0.18 }),
    saffron: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.saffron, roughness: 0.4 }),
    marigold: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.marigold, roughness: 0.4 }),
    tulsi: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.tulsi, roughness: 0.45 }),
    cream: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.cream, roughness: 0.5 }),
    ink: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.ink, roughness: 0.45 }),
    blood: new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: C.blood,
      roughness: 0.38,
      sheen: 1,
      sheenColor: new THREE.Color('#FF9B7A'),
      sheenRoughness: 0.5,
      clearcoat: 0.35,
    }),
    lamp: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.marigold, emissive: C.marigold, emissiveIntensity: 1.6 }),
  };
}

/** Shared materials (one instance per material for the whole scene) */
export function labMaterials() {
  if (!cache) cache = build();
  return cache;
}
```

## File: components/three/objects.ts

```ts
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { GLTF, GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
import { labMaterials, C } from './materials';
import { scrollState } from '@/lib/scroll-store';

const { damp } = THREE.MathUtils;

/**
 * Every builder returns a root object plus an optional per-frame update.
 * Updates receive elapsed seconds and delta seconds from THREE.Timer, so
 * motion is identical at 60, 120 or 144 Hz.
 *
 * Lab objects are real model files (public/models/lab, credits in
 * lib/model-credits.ts). They load asynchronously into their group; the
 * station is simply empty for the few ms before a file arrives.
 */
export interface LabObject {
  object: THREE.Object3D;
  update?: (t: number, dt: number) => void;
}

/** Deterministic PRNG (mulberry32): same layout on every load */
function rng(seed: number) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

const mesh = (g: THREE.BufferGeometry, m: THREE.Material, p?: THREE.Vector3Tuple, r?: THREE.Vector3Tuple) => {
  const o = new THREE.Mesh(g, m);
  if (p) o.position.set(...p);
  if (r) o.rotation.set(...r);
  return o;
};

/* ───────────────────────────── Model loading ──────────────────────── */
const LAB = '/models/lab/';
const cache = new Map<string, Promise<GLTF>>();
const load = (loader: GLTFLoader, file: string) => {
  if (!cache.has(file)) cache.set(file, loader.loadAsync(LAB + file));
  return cache.get(file)!;
};
/** Clear between scene instances (React StrictMode / reduced-motion toggle) */
export const clearModelCache = () => cache.clear();

type Recolor = (src: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial, hsl: { h: number; s: number; l: number }) => THREE.Material | undefined;

const flatCache = new Map<THREE.Material, THREE.Material>();
const flat = (m: THREE.Material) => {
  if (!flatCache.has(m)) {
    const c = (m as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial).clone();
    c.flatShading = true;
    flatCache.set(m, c);
  }
  return flatCache.get(m)!;
};

/**
 * Map a model's original material onto the brand palette by colour, so every
 * third-party file reads as one art-directed set (Saffron & Neel).
 */
function brandMaterial(src: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial, override?: Recolor): THREE.Material {
  const m = labMaterials();
  const hsl = { h: 0, s: 0, l: 0 };
  src.color.getHSL(hsl);
  const o = override?.(src, hsl);
  if (o) return o;
  if (src.transparent || src.opacity < 0.99) return m.glass;
  if (src.map) return src; // textured models keep their artwork
  const { h, s, l } = hsl;
  if (s < 0.15) return l > 0.72 ? m.enamel : l < 0.2 ? m.inkMetal : m.chrome;
  if (h < 0.07 || h > 0.93) return m.saffron;
  if (h < 0.17) return m.marigold;
  if (h < 0.45) return m.tulsi;
  if (h < 0.55) return m.chrome;
  return m.ink;
}

interface ModelOpts {
  /** largest dimension after normalising, in world units */
  size: number;
  recolor?: Recolor;
  /** model ships without normals (welded for size) → flat shading */
  flatShade?: boolean;
  /** keep original materials */
  keepMaterials?: boolean;
  /** drop parts of the file we don't want (e.g. a display plinth) */
  drop?: (src: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial) => boolean;
}

/** Centre a model on its bounding box and scale its largest side to `size`. */
function normalise(obj: THREE.Object3D, size: number) {
  const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(obj);
  const dim = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  const ctr = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const s = size / Math.max(dim.x, dim.y, dim.z);
  obj.scale.setScalar(s);
  obj.position.copy(ctr).multiplyScalar(-s);
}

function prepare(scene: THREE.Object3D, o: ModelOpts) {
  if (o.drop) {
    const doomed: THREE.Object3D[] = [];
    scene.traverse((n) => {
      const mesh = n as THREE.Mesh;
      if (mesh.isMesh && o.drop!(mesh.material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial)) doomed.push(mesh);
    });
    doomed.forEach((d) => d.removeFromParent());
  }
  scene.traverse((n) => {
    const mesh = n as THREE.Mesh;
    if (!mesh.isMesh) return;
    // some files ship without normals (welded for size): unlit-black otherwise
    if (!mesh.geometry.attributes.normal) mesh.geometry.computeVertexNormals();
    if (o.keepMaterials) return;
    const mats = Array.isArray(mesh.material) ? mesh.material : [mesh.material];
    const next = mats.map((mat) => {
      const b = brandMaterial(mat as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial, o.recolor);
      return o.flatShade && b !== labMaterials().glass ? flat(b) : b;
    });
    mesh.material = Array.isArray(mesh.material) ? next : next[0];
    if (next.includes(labMaterials().glass)) mesh.renderOrder = 2;
  });
}

/** Load a model file into a group (normalised + brand-recoloured). */
function model(loader: GLTFLoader, file: string, o: ModelOpts, onReady?: (root: THREE.Object3D) => void) {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  load(loader, file).then((gltf) => {
    const scene = gltf.scene.clone(true);
    prepare(scene, o);
    const holder = new THREE.Group();
    holder.add(scene);
    normalise(scene, o.size);
    group.add(holder);
    onReady?.(holder);
  });
  return group;
}

const spin = (obj: THREE.Object3D, animate: boolean, y = 0.22, x = 0) => (_: number, dt: number) => {
  if (!animate) return;
  obj.rotation.y += dt * y;
  obj.rotation.x += dt * x;
};

/* ─────────────────────────────── DNA ──────────────────────────────── */
export function dnaHelix(loader: GLTFLoader, { size = 5.2, animate = true } = {}): LabObject {
  const g = model(loader, 'dna.glb', { size });
  return { object: g, update: spin(g, animate) };
}

/* ─────────────────────────── Red blood cells ──────────────────────── */
export function bloodCells(loader: GLTFLoader, { count = 9, spread = 3, animate = true, seed = 11, cellSize = 0.75 } = {}): LabObject {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  const rand = rng(seed);
  // Non-overlapping layout: centres stay further apart than the largest cell
  // diameter (+ bob room), so cells never touch whatever way they rotate.
  const S_MAX = 1.15;
  const minDist = cellSize * S_MAX + 0.3;
  const cells: { x: number; y: number; z: number; rx: number; ry: number; s: number; v: number }[] = [];
  let area = spread;
  for (let tries = 0; cells.length < count; tries++) {
    if (tries > 0 && tries % 200 === 0) area *= 1.15; // too crowded: widen the cluster
    const p = { x: (rand() - 0.5) * area, y: (rand() - 0.5) * area, z: (rand() - 0.5) * 1.2 };
    if (cells.some((c) => Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.y - p.y, c.z - p.z) < minDist)) continue;
    cells.push({ ...p, rx: rand() * 6, ry: rand() * 6, s: 0.85 + rand() * (S_MAX - 0.85), v: 0.15 + rand() * 0.3 });
  }
  let im: THREE.InstancedMesh | null = null;
  let base = 1;
  const o = new THREE.Object3D();
  const place = (t: number) => {
    if (!im) return;
    cells.forEach((c, i) => {
      o.position.set(c.x, c.y + Math.sin(t * c.v + i) * 0.12, c.z);
      o.rotation.set(c.rx + t * c.v, c.ry + t * c.v * 0.7, 0);
      o.scale.setScalar(c.s * base);
      o.updateMatrix();
      im!.setMatrixAt(i, o.matrix);
    });
    im.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  };

  load(loader, 'rbc.glb').then((gltf) => {
    let src: THREE.Mesh | null = null;
    gltf.scene.traverse((n) => {
      if (!src && (n as THREE.Mesh).isMesh) src = n as THREE.Mesh;
    });
    if (!src) return;
    const geo = (src as THREE.Mesh).geometry.clone();
    geo.computeBoundingBox();
    geo.center();
    const dim = geo.boundingBox!.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
    base = cellSize / Math.max(dim.x, dim.y, dim.z);
    if (!geo.attributes.normal) geo.computeVertexNormals();
    im = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, labMaterials().blood, count);
    im.frustumCulled = false;
    group.add(im);
    place(0);
  });

  return { object: group, update: (t) => animate && place(t) };
}

/* ───────────────────── Test tubes (services index) ────────────────── */
// Real sample colours: whole blood, serum, plasma, urine-ish, clot, heparin
const FILLS = ['#8E1F12', '#E8B04A', '#B9372A', '#D9A441', '#7A1A10', '#C2410C'];

export function testTubes(loader: GLTFLoader, count = 6): LabObject {
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  const spacing = 0.5;
  const lifts: THREE.Group[] = [];
  const fills = FILLS.map((c) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: c, roughness: 0.25 }));
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const lift = new THREE.Group();
    lift.position.x = (i - (count - 1) / 2) * spacing;
    // liquid = the opaque material; recolour it per tube
    lift.add(model(loader, 'tube.glb', { size: 1.9, recolor: (src) => (src.transparent ? undefined : fills[i % fills.length]) }));
    root.add(lift);
    lifts.push(lift);
  }
  return {
    object: root,
    // Services list hover lifts the matching tube
    update: (_, dt) =>
      lifts.forEach((g, i) => {
        const on = scrollState.hoverService === i;
        g.position.y = damp(g.position.y, on ? 0.6 : 0, 8, dt);
        g.rotation.z = damp(g.rotation.z, on ? -0.1 : 0, 6, dt);
      }),
  };
}

/* ───────────────────────────── Microscope ─────────────────────────── */
export function microscope(loader: GLTFLoader, animate = true): LabObject {
  const g = model(loader, 'microscope.glb', {
    size: 3,
    flatShade: true,
    // the source file stands on a steel-blue display plinth; keep only the instrument
    drop: ({ color: c }) => c.b > c.r * 1.6 && c.b < 0.2 && c.g < 0.15,
  });
  return { object: g, update: spin(g, animate, 0.12) };
}

/* ───────────────── Home collection: syringe + sample tube ─────────── */
export function sampleKit(loader: GLTFLoader, animate = true): LabObject {
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  const syringe = model(loader, 'syringe.glb', { size: 2.8 });
  syringe.rotation.set(0.2, 0, -0.75);
  const tube = model(loader, 'tube.glb', { size: 1.6, recolor: (src) => (src.transparent ? undefined : labMaterials().blood) });
  tube.position.set(0.9, -0.5, 0.4);
  tube.rotation.z = 0.25;
  root.add(syringe, tube);
  return {
    object: root,
    update: (t) => {
      if (!animate) return;
      syringe.position.y = Math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.08;
      tube.position.y = -0.5 + Math.sin(t * 0.8 + 1.4) * 0.1;
    },
  };
}

/* ─────────────────────────── Flask / rack / molecule ──────────────── */
export function flask(loader: GLTFLoader, animate = true): LabObject {
  const g = model(loader, 'flask.glb', { size: 2.2, recolor: (src) => (src.transparent ? undefined : labMaterials().saffron) });
  return { object: g, update: spin(g, animate, 0.18) };
}

export function rack(loader: GLTFLoader): LabObject {
  const m = labMaterials();
  // the wooden frame becomes Neel ink so it reads against the cream page
  return { object: model(loader, 'rack.glb', { size: 2.4, recolor: (_, { h, s, l }) => (h < 0.1 && s > 0.5 && l < 0.5 ? m.inkMetal : undefined) }) };
}

export function molecule(loader: GLTFLoader, animate = true): LabObject {
  const g = model(loader, 'molecule.glb', { size: 5.2 });
  return { object: g, update: spin(g, animate, 0.3, 0.08) };
}

/* ─────────────────────────── White blood cell ─────────────────────── */
export function whiteCell(loader: GLTFLoader, animate = true): LabObject {
  const g = model(loader, 'wbc.glb', { size: 1.8, keepMaterials: true }, (root) =>
    root.traverse((n) => {
      const mesh = n as THREE.Mesh;
      if (mesh.isMesh) {
        const mat = (mesh.material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial).clone();
        mat.color = C.cream.clone().lerp(C.marigold, 0.12);
        mat.roughness = 0.55;
        mesh.material = mat;
      }
    }),
  );
  return { object: g, update: spin(g, animate, 0.16, 0.05) };
}

/* ─────────────────────────────── Pills ────────────────────────────── */
export function pills(loader: GLTFLoader, { animate = true, spread = 2.6, seed = 3 } = {}): LabObject {
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  const rand = rng(seed);
  const files = ['capsule.glb', 'pill-a.glb', 'pill-b.glb', 'capsule.glb', 'pill-a.glb', 'capsule.glb'];
  const items = files.map((file) => {
    const g = model(loader, file, { size: 0.75, keepMaterials: file === 'capsule.glb' });
    g.position.set((rand() - 0.5) * spread, (rand() - 0.5) * spread, (rand() - 0.5) * 1.2);
    g.rotation.set(rand() * 3, rand() * 3, rand() * 3);
    root.add(g);
    return { g, v: 0.2 + rand() * 0.4 };
  });
  return {
    object: root,
    update: (_, dt) => {
      if (!animate) return;
      for (const { g, v } of items) {
        g.rotation.x += dt * v;
        g.rotation.z += dt * v * 0.6;
      }
    },
  };
}

/* ───────────────────────── Holographic body scan ──────────────────── */
// Model: "3D Male Base Mesh" by orange-juice-games, CC0 1.0 (public domain)
// https://github.com/BoQsc/Godot-Male-Base-Mesh → public/models/human.glb
export const HUMAN_URL = '/models/human.glb';
const HUMAN_HEIGHT = 3.4;

/** Focus height (feet at 0, body 3.4 tall) per test category */
export const BODY_REGIONS: Record<string, number> = {
  Endocrinology: 2.8, // thyroid
  Cardiology: 2.42, // heart
  Immunology: 2.55, // chest lymph nodes
  Biochemistry: 2.15, // liver
  Diabetology: 2.02, // pancreas
  Gynaecology: 1.72, // pelvis
  Haematology: 1.95,
  Pathology: 1.95,
  Paediatrics: 1.95,
  General: 1.95,
};

const holoVertex = /* glsl */ `
  uniform float uMinY;
  uniform float uScale;
  varying vec3 vN;
  varying vec3 vV;
  varying float vY;
  void main() {
    vY = (position.y - uMinY) * uScale;
    vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    vV = -mv.xyz;
    vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
    gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
  }
`;
const holoFragment = /* glsl */ `
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform float uScan;
  uniform float uFocus;
  uniform float uFocusAmt;
  uniform vec3 uInk;
  uniform vec3 uHot;
  varying vec3 vN;
  varying vec3 vV;
  varying float vY;
  void main() {
    float fres = pow(1.0 - abs(dot(normalize(vN), normalize(vV))), 2.0);
    float band = smoothstep(0.14, 0.0, abs(vY - uScan));
    float lines = smoothstep(0.42, 0.5, fract(vY * 26.0 - uTime * 0.4)) * 0.16;
    float focus = smoothstep(0.3, 0.0, abs(vY - uFocus)) * uFocusAmt;
    vec3 col = mix(uInk, uHot, clamp(band + focus, 0.0, 1.0));
    float a = fres * 0.9 + band * 0.55 + focus * 0.5 + lines * fres + 0.05;
    gl_FragColor = vec4(col, clamp(a, 0.0, 0.95));
  }
`;

export function holoHuman(loader: GLTFLoader, animate = true): LabObject {
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  const uniforms = {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uScan: { value: 1.7 },
    uFocus: { value: 1.95 },
    uFocusAmt: { value: 0 },
    uMinY: { value: 0 },
    uScale: { value: 1 },
    uInk: { value: C.ink.clone() },
    uHot: { value: C.saffron.clone() },
  };
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ vertexShader: holoVertex, fragmentShader: holoFragment, uniforms, transparent: true, depthWrite: false });

  loader.load(HUMAN_URL, (gltf) => {
    let src: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;
    gltf.scene.traverse((o) => {
      if (!src && (o as THREE.Mesh).isMesh) src = (o as THREE.Mesh).geometry;
    });
    if (!src) return;
    // Static A-pose: the skinned mesh's bind-pose geometry, no skeleton needed
    const geo = (src as THREE.BufferGeometry).clone();
    geo.computeVertexNormals();
    geo.computeBoundingBox();
    const bb = geo.boundingBox!;
    const scale = HUMAN_HEIGHT / (bb.max.y - bb.min.y);
    uniforms.uMinY.value = bb.min.y;
    uniforms.uScale.value = scale;
    const body = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    body.scale.setScalar(scale);
    body.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2; // model faces +x; turn it toward the camera
    body.position.y = -bb.min.y * scale;
    root.add(body);
  });

  const heart = mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.065, 16, 16), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: C.saffron, emissive: C.saffron, emissiveIntensity: 0.9 }), [0.08, BODY_REGIONS.Cardiology, 0.14]);
  const ring = mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.62, 0.66, 64), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: C.saffron, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 }), [0, 0.01, 0], [-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]);
  const disc = mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.62, 64), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: C.ink, transparent: true, opacity: 0.08 }), [0, 0, 0], [-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]);
  root.add(heart, ring, disc);

  return {
    object: root,
    update: (t, dt) => {
      uniforms.uTime.value = t;
      uniforms.uScan.value = animate ? 0.1 + ((Math.sin(t * 0.6) + 1) / 2) * (HUMAN_HEIGHT - 0.2) : BODY_REGIONS.Cardiology;
      const region = scrollState.bodyRegion ? BODY_REGIONS[scrollState.bodyRegion] : undefined;
      uniforms.uFocusAmt.value = damp(uniforms.uFocusAmt.value, region !== undefined ? 1 : 0, 5, dt);
      if (region !== undefined) uniforms.uFocus.value = damp(uniforms.uFocus.value, region, 6, dt);
      if (animate) heart.scale.setScalar(1 + Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 7)) * 0.18);
    },
  };
}

/* ─────────────────────────── Ambient particles ────────────────────── */
export function particles(count = 500, depth = 70): LabObject {
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  const p = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const rand = rng(101);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    p[i * 3] = (rand() - 0.5) * 18;
    p[i * 3 + 1] = 4 - rand() * depth;
    p[i * 3 + 2] = -7 + rand() * 8;
  }
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(p, 3));
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = 64;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d')!;
  const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
  grd.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
  grd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = grd;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ map: new THREE.CanvasTexture(c), color: C.saffron, size: 0.09, sizeAttenuation: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false });
  return { object: new THREE.Points(g, mat) };
}
```

## File: components/ui/BookButton.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { useBookTest } from '@/context/BookTestContext';
import Icon from '@/components/ui/Icon';

type Variant = 'primary' | 'navy' | 'link' | 'chip';

const STYLES: Record<Variant, string> = {
  primary:
    'group press inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-full bg-saffron py-2 pl-6 pr-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-[0_10px_30px_-10px_rgba(194,65,12,0.6)] transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-saffron-deep',
  navy:
    'group press inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-full bg-navy py-2 pl-6 pr-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-navy-mid',
  link: 'group inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold',
  chip:
    'press rounded-full bg-navy-pale px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-navy transition-colors duration-200 hover:bg-navy hover:text-white',
};

interface Props {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  variant?: Variant;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  /** Show trailing arrow (button-in-button for primary/navy) */
  arrow?: boolean;
}

/** Opens the Book-a-Test dialog. Lets sections stay Server Components. */
export default function BookButton({ children, variant = 'primary', className = '', style, arrow = true }: Props) {
  const { openDialog } = useBookTest();
  const nested = variant === 'primary' || variant === 'navy';

  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={openDialog} className={`${STYLES[variant]} ${className}`} style={style}>
      {children}
      {arrow && nested && (
        <span className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15 transition-transform duration-200 ease-out-strong group-hover:-translate-y-px group-hover:translate-x-0.5">
          <Icon name="ArrowUpRight" size={16} weight="bold" />
        </span>
      )}
      {arrow && variant === 'link' && (
        <Icon name="ArrowRight" size={14} className="transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
      )}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { IconProps as PhosphorProps, Icon as PhosphorIcon } from '@phosphor-icons/react';
import {
  ActivityIcon,
  ArrowLeftIcon,
  ArrowRightIcon,
  ArrowUpRightIcon,
  CaretDownIcon,
  ChatCircleIcon,
  CheckCircleIcon,
  ClockIcon,
  DownloadSimpleIcon,
  DropIcon,
  EnvelopeSimpleIcon,
  GlobeIcon,
  HandHeartIcon,
  HeartIcon,
  HeartbeatIcon,
  HouseLineIcon,
  LightningIcon,
  ListIcon,
  LockKeyIcon,
  MapPinIcon,
  MedalIcon,
  MicroscopeIcon,
  MinusIcon,
  PhoneIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  QuotesIcon,
  SealCheckIcon,
  ShieldCheckIcon,
  StarIcon,
  StethoscopeIcon,
  TestTubeIcon,
  TruckIcon,
  UsersThreeIcon,
  WhatsappLogoIcon,
  XIcon,
} from '@phosphor-icons/react/dist/ssr';

/**
 * Single icon registry. Config JSON stores icon names (kept from the
 * original Lucide names so content files don't change); this maps them
 * to Phosphor SVG icons.
 */
const REGISTRY = {
  Activity: ActivityIcon,
  ArrowLeft: ArrowLeftIcon,
  ArrowRight: ArrowRightIcon,
  ArrowUpRight: ArrowUpRightIcon,
  Award: MedalIcon,
  BadgeCheck: SealCheckIcon,
  CaretDown: CaretDownIcon,
  Chat: ChatCircleIcon,
  CheckCircle2: CheckCircleIcon,
  Clock: ClockIcon,
  Download: DownloadSimpleIcon,
  Droplets: DropIcon,
  Globe: GlobeIcon,
  Heart: HeartIcon,
  HeartHandshake: HandHeartIcon,
  HeartPulse: HeartbeatIcon,
  Home: HouseLineIcon,
  Lock: LockKeyIcon,
  Mail: EnvelopeSimpleIcon,
  MapPin: MapPinIcon,
  Menu: ListIcon,
  Microscope: MicroscopeIcon,
  Minus: MinusIcon,
  Phone: PhoneIcon,
  Plus: PlusIcon,
  Quote: QuotesIcon,
  Shield: ShieldCheckIcon,
  Star: StarIcon,
  Stethoscope: StethoscopeIcon,
  TestTube2: TestTubeIcon,
  Truck: TruckIcon,
  Users: UsersThreeIcon,
  WhatsApp: WhatsappLogoIcon,
  X: XIcon,
  Zap: LightningIcon,
} satisfies Record<string, PhosphorIcon>;

export type IconName = keyof typeof REGISTRY;

interface Props extends Omit<PhosphorProps, 'ref'> {
  name: IconName | (string & {});
  fallback?: IconName;
}

export default function Icon({ name, fallback = 'TestTube2', weight = 'light', ...rest }: Props) {
  const Cmp = REGISTRY[name as IconName] ?? REGISTRY[fallback];
  return <Cmp weight={weight} aria-hidden="true" {...rest} />;
}
```

## File: components/ui/SectionHeading.tsx

```tsx
interface Props {
  heading: string;
  accent?: string;
  subtext?: string;
  tone?: 'light' | 'dark';
  /** Accent on its own line (default) or inline after the heading */
  stack?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/** Section title. No kicker/eyebrow: the heading carries its own weight. */
export default function SectionHeading({ heading, accent, subtext, tone = 'light', stack = true, className = '' }: Props) {
  const dark = tone === 'dark';
  return (
    <div data-reveal className={`mb-12 lg:mb-14 ${className}`}>
      <h2 className={`text-balance font-display text-4xl font-semibold leading-[1.04] sm:text-5xl lg:text-[3.5rem] ${dark ? 'text-white' : 'text-navy'}`}>
        {heading}
        {accent && (
          <>
            {stack ? <br /> : ' '}
            <span className={`font-light ${dark ? 'text-amber' : 'text-saffron'}`}>{accent}</span>
          </>
        )}
      </h2>
      {subtext && <p className={`mt-5 max-w-[52ch] text-base leading-relaxed ${dark ? 'text-white/70' : 'text-muted'}`}>{subtext}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## File: context/BookTestContext.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { createContext, useContext, useState, ReactNode } from 'react';

interface BookTestContextType {
  isOpen: boolean;
  openDialog: () => void;
  closeDialog: () => void;
}

const BookTestContext = createContext<BookTestContextType | null>(null);

export function BookTestProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <BookTestContext.Provider
      value={{
        isOpen,
        openDialog: () => setIsOpen(true),
        closeDialog: () => setIsOpen(false),
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </BookTestContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useBookTest() {
  const ctx = useContext(BookTestContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useBookTest must be inside BookTestProvider');
  return ctx;
}
```

## File: lib/config.ts

```ts
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  MGPL Diagnostics — Site Configuration
//
//  Every JSON file is validated against its TypeScript interface
//  (lib/types.ts) at compile time via the `satisfies` operator.
//  If a field is missing or wrong type in a JSON, tsc will fail.
//
//  Content is split across focused files in lib/config/:
//
//    brand.json           → BrandConfig
//    contact.json         → ContactConfig
//    nav.json             → NavConfig
//    hero.json            → HeroConfig
//    metrics.json         → MetricsConfig
//    services.json        → ServicesConfig
//    why-choose.json      → WhyChooseConfig
//    home-collection.json → HomeCollectionConfig
//    catalogue.json       → CatalogueConfig
//    testimonials.json    → TestimonialsConfig
//    doctors.json         → DoctorsConfig
//    faq.json             → FaqConfig
//    footer.json          → FooterConfig
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import type {
  BrandConfig,
  ContactConfig,
  NavConfig,
  HeroConfig,
  MetricsConfig,
  ServicesConfig,
  WhyChooseConfig,
  HomeCollectionConfig,
  CatalogueConfig,
  TestimonialsConfig,
  DoctorsConfig,
  FaqConfig,
  FooterConfig,
  SiteConfig,
} from './types';

import _brand          from './config/brand.json';
import _contact        from './config/contact.json';
import _nav            from './config/nav.json';
import _hero           from './config/hero.json';
import _metrics        from './config/metrics.json';
import _services       from './config/services.json';
import _whyChoose      from './config/why-choose.json';
import _homeCollection from './config/home-collection.json';
import _catalogue      from './config/catalogue.json';
import _testimonials   from './config/testimonials.json';
import _doctors        from './config/doctors.json';
import _faq            from './config/faq.json';
import _footer         from './config/footer.json';

// Validate each JSON slice against its interface at compile time.
// `satisfies` keeps the literal types while enforcing the shape.
const brand          = _brand          satisfies BrandConfig;
const contact        = _contact        satisfies ContactConfig;
const nav            = _nav            satisfies NavConfig;
const hero           = _hero           satisfies HeroConfig;
const metrics        = _metrics        satisfies MetricsConfig;
const services       = _services       satisfies ServicesConfig;
const whyChoose      = _whyChoose      satisfies WhyChooseConfig;
const homeCollection = _homeCollection satisfies HomeCollectionConfig;
const catalogue      = _catalogue      satisfies CatalogueConfig;
const testimonials   = _testimonials   satisfies TestimonialsConfig;
const doctors        = _doctors        satisfies DoctorsConfig;
const faq            = _faq            satisfies FaqConfig;
const footer         = _footer         satisfies FooterConfig;

// Full typed config — spread from all validated slices.
export const cfg: SiteConfig = {
  ...brand,
  ...contact,
  ...nav,
  ...hero,
  ...metrics,
  ...services,
  ...whyChoose,
  ...homeCollection,
  ...catalogue,
  ...testimonials,
  ...doctors,
  ...faq,
  ...footer,
};

// Backward-compatible flat shape used by legacy components.
export const siteConfig = {
  name:        cfg.brand.name,
  fullName:    cfg.brand.fullName,
  tagline:     cfg.brand.tagline,
  subTagline:  cfg.brand.subTagline,
  description: cfg.brand.description,
  foundedYear: cfg.brand.foundedYear,

  logo:       cfg.assets.logo,

  phone:      cfg.contact.phone,
  email:      cfg.contact.email,

  address:    cfg.address,
  googleMaps: cfg.maps,

  hours:      cfg.hours,
  social:     cfg.social,
  seo:        cfg.seo,
} as const;

export type { SiteConfig } from './types';
```

```json
        "a": "Fasting (8–12 hours, water only) is required for tests like fasting glucose, lipid profile, and some liver function tests. Tests such as CBC, thyroid, HbA1c, and vitamin panels generally do not require fasting. Our team informs you at booking."
      },
      {
        "q": "What is the home collection charge?",
        "a": "We currently offer home collection at no additional charge for most standard test panels. For remote addresses or after-hours collection, a nominal fee may apply — which is always disclosed upfront at the time of booking."
      },
      {
        "q": "Can I get a consultation after my reports?",
        "a": "Yes. Our pathologists are available for brief report consultations. For detailed clinical advice, we recommend consulting your family physician or specialist with the MGPL report in hand — our reports include reference ranges and interpretation notes."
      },
      {
        "q": "How are samples handled and transported?",
        "a": "All samples are collected in pre-labelled, sealed, medical-grade tubes and transported in temperature-controlled carriers within 2 hours of collection. Our chain-of-custody process ensures sample integrity from your home to the lab."
      },
      {
        "q": "Do you serve all areas of Raipur?",
        "a": "Yes, we provide home collection services across Raipur and surrounding areas in Chhattisgarh. Call us or book online to confirm availability for your specific location."
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## File: lib/gsap.ts

```ts
'use client';

import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger';
import { ScrollSmoother } from 'gsap/ScrollSmoother';
import { SplitText } from 'gsap/SplitText';
import { CustomEase } from 'gsap/CustomEase';
import { ScrollToPlugin } from 'gsap/ScrollToPlugin';
import { useGSAP } from '@gsap/react';

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, ScrollSmoother, ScrollToPlugin, SplitText, CustomEase, useGSAP);

  // Same curves as the CSS tokens in globals.css (--ease-out, --ease-in-out, --ease-drawer)
  CustomEase.create('ui-out', '0.23, 1, 0.32, 1');
  CustomEase.create('ui-in-out', '0.77, 0, 0.175, 1');
  CustomEase.create('ui-drawer', '0.32, 0.72, 0, 1');

  gsap.defaults({ ease: 'ui-out', duration: 0.6 });
}

export const prefersReducedMotion = () =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

export const hasFinePointer = () =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;

/**
 * Scroll to a selector/element. Uses ScrollSmoother when it is running,
 * otherwise ScrollToPlugin (reduced-motion visitors get an instant jump).
 */
export function scrollToTarget(target: string | Element, offset = 96) {
  const smoother = ScrollSmoother.get();
  if (smoother) {
    smoother.scrollTo(target, true, `top ${offset}px`);
    return;
  }
  gsap.to(window, {
    duration: prefersReducedMotion() ? 0 : 0.9,
    ease: 'ui-in-out',
    scrollTo: { y: target, offsetY: offset, autoKill: true },
  });
}

/** Pause smooth scrolling (or native scroll) while a modal is open. */
export function setScrollLocked(locked: boolean) {
  const smoother = ScrollSmoother.get();
  if (smoother) smoother.paused(locked);
  else document.documentElement.style.overflow = locked ? 'hidden' : '';
}

export { gsap, ScrollTrigger, ScrollSmoother, ScrollToPlugin, SplitText, useGSAP };
```


---

## File: lib/model-credits.ts

```ts
/**
 * Third-party 3D models used by the Living Lab scene. CC-BY requires visible
 * credit (title, author, source, licence) — rendered in the footer.
 * Files in public/models are optimised copies (quantised, recoloured at runtime).
 */
export interface ModelCredit {
  file: string;
  title: string;
  author: string;
  source: string;
  license: 'CC-BY 3.0' | 'CC0 1.0';
}

const CC_BY = 'CC-BY 3.0' as const;

export const MODEL_CREDITS: ModelCredit[] = [
  { file: '/models/lab/dna.glb', title: 'DNA', author: 'Zoe XR', source: 'https://poly.pizza/m/0e5xgkdcuEW', license: CC_BY },

  { file: '/models/lab/rbc.glb', title: 'Red blood cell (Evans–Fung geometry)', author: 'MGPL Diagnostics', source: 'https://doi.org/10.1016/0026-2862(72)90069-6', license: 'CC0 1.0' },
```

## File: lib/scroll-store.ts

```ts
/**
 * Mutable state shared between the DOM (GSAP/ScrollTrigger, React handlers)
 * and the Three.js scene. Read it inside useFrame; never put it in React
 * state — it changes every frame.
 */
export const scrollState = {
  /** 0 → 1 across the whole page */
  progress: 0,
  /** px/s, signed */
  velocity: 0,
  /**
   * Continuous station index: 0 at the hero, 1 when the second
   * [data-station] section is centred, and so on. Drives the camera.
   */
  station: 0,
  /** Services list hover → matching test tube lifts. -1 = none */
  hoverService: -1,
  /** Test catalogue category → body-scan focus region (see BODY_REGIONS) */
  bodyRegion: null as string | null,
};
```

## File: lib/types.ts

```ts
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  MGPL Diagnostics — Config Type Definitions
//  Every JSON file in lib/config/ is validated against these
//  interfaces at compile time via the `satisfies` operator.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── brand.json ────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface Brand {
  name: string;
  fullName: string;
  tagline: string;
  subTagline: string;
  description: string;
  foundedYear: number;
}

export interface LogoAsset {
  src: string;
  /** Reversed variant for navy surfaces (footer). */
  darkSrc: string;
  /** Icon + MGPL/DIAGNOSTICS without tagline, for the navbar. */
  compactSrc: string;
  compactWidth: number;
  compactHeight: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  navbarHeight: number;
}

export interface Assets {
  logo: LogoAsset;
}

export interface Seo {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  keywords: string;
  locale: string;
}

export interface BrandConfig {
  brand: Brand;
  assets: Assets;
  seo: Seo;
}

// ── contact.json ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface Phone {
  primary: string;
  primaryTel: string;
  secondary: string;
  secondaryTel: string;
  whatsapp: string;
}

export interface Email {
  info: string;
  reports: string;
}

export interface Contact {
  phone: Phone;
  email: Email;
}

export interface Address {
  line1: string;
  line2: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  pin: string;
  full: string;
}

export interface Maps {
  shareLink: string;
  embedSrc: string;
}

export interface Hours {
  display: string;
  short: string;
}

export interface Social {
  website: string;
  facebook: string;
  instagram: string;
  youtube: string;
}

export interface ContactConfig {
  contact: Contact;
  address: Address;
  maps: Maps;
  hours: Hours;
  social: Social;
}

// ── nav.json ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface NavLink {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

export interface Nav {
  links: NavLink[];
  ctaLabel: string;
}

export interface BookDialogOption {
  label: string;
  description: string;
  subtext: string;
}

export interface BookTestDialog {
  heading: string;
  subtext: string;
  whatsapp: BookDialogOption;
  call: BookDialogOption;
}

export interface NavConfig {
  nav: Nav;
  bookTestDialog: BookTestDialog;
}

// ── hero.json ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface HeroHeadline {
  line1: string;
  line2: string;
  line3: string;
  line4: string;
}

export interface HeroSocialProof {
  patientsServed: string;
  patientsLabel: string;
  rating: string;
  ratingOutOf: string;
  avatarInitials: string[];
}

export interface ReportMetric {
  name: string;
  value: string;
  ref: string;
  ok: boolean;
}

export interface HeroReportCard {
  title: string;
  testName: string;
  reportId: string;
  footerVerified: string;
  footerTurnaround: string;
  metrics: ReportMetric[];
}

export interface Hero {
  badge: string;
  headline: HeroHeadline;
  subtext: string;
  ctaPrimary: string;
  ctaSecondary: string;
  socialProof: HeroSocialProof;
  reportCard: HeroReportCard;
}

export interface HeroConfig {
  hero: Hero;
}

// ── metrics.json ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TrustMetric {
  icon: string;
  end: number;
  suffix: string;
  label: string;
  sub: string;
}

export interface MetricsConfig {
  trustMetrics: TrustMetric[];
}

// ── services.json ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ServiceItem {
  icon: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  iconColor: string;
  iconBg: string;
}

export interface Services {
  sectionTag: string;
  heading: string;
  headingAccent: string;
  subtext: string;
  viewAllLabel: string;
  items: ServiceItem[];
}

export interface ServicesConfig {
  services: Services;
}

// ── why-choose.json ───────────────────────────────────────────

export interface FeatureItem {
  icon: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  iconColor: string;
  iconBg: string;
}

export interface WhyChoose {
  sectionTag: string;
  headingLine1: string;
  headingLine2: string;
  headingLine3: string;
  subtext: string;
  quote: string;
  quoteAttrib: string;
  features: FeatureItem[];
}

export interface WhyChooseConfig {
  whyChoose: WhyChoose;
}

// ── home-collection.json ──────────────────────────────────────

export interface CollectionStep {
  number: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;
}

export interface HomeCollection {
  sectionTag: string;
  heading: string;
  headingAccent: string;
  subtext: string;
  steps: CollectionStep[];
  cardTitle: string;
  cardSubtitle: string;
  features: string[];
  ctaLabel: string;
}

export interface HomeCollectionConfig {
  homeCollection: HomeCollection;
}

// ── catalogue.json ────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CatalogueCategory {
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
}

export interface PopularTest {
  name: string;
  price: string;
  turnaround: string;
  tag: string;
}

export interface TestItem {
  name: string;
  price: string;
  turnaround: string;
  preparation: string;
  parameters?: string;
}

export interface TestGroup {
  category: string;
  tests: TestItem[];
}

export interface TestCatalogue {
  sectionTag: string;
  heading: string;
  headingAccent: string;
  popularTestsHeading: string;
  allTestsHeading: string;
  allTestsSubtext: string;
  bookLabel: string;
  preparationLabel: string;
  parametersLabel: string;
  backLabel: string;
  categories: CatalogueCategory[];
  popularTests: PopularTest[];
  allTests: TestGroup[];
}

export interface CatalogueConfig {
  testCatalogue: TestCatalogue;
}

// ── testimonials.json ─────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RatingInfo {
  score: string;
  maxScore: string;
  reviewCount: string;
}

export interface TestimonialItem {
  name: string;
  location: string;
  initials: string;
  rating: number;
  testType: string;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
}

export interface Testimonials {
  sectionTag: string;
  heading: string;
  headingAccent: string;
  subtext: string;
  rating: RatingInfo;
  items: TestimonialItem[];
}

export interface TestimonialsConfig {
  testimonials: Testimonials;
}

// ── doctors.json ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface DoctorStat {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}

export interface DoctorItem {
  name: string;
  qualification: string;
  specialization: string;
  experience: string;
  initials: string;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
}

export interface Doctors {
  sectionTag: string;
  heading: string;
  headingAccent: string;
  subtext: string;
  stats: DoctorStat[];
  items: DoctorItem[];
}

export interface DoctorsConfig {
  doctors: Doctors;
}

// ── faq.json ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface FaqItem {
  q: string;
  a: string;
}

export interface Faq {
  sectionTag: string;
  heading: string;
  headingAccent: string;
  subtext: string;
  stillHaveQuestionsTitle: string;
  stillHaveQuestionsSubtext: string;
  callCtaLabel: string;
  items: FaqItem[];
}

export interface FaqConfig {
  faq: Faq;
}

// ── footer.json ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface FooterLink {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

export interface FooterColumn {
  heading: string;
  links: FooterLink[];
}

export interface FooterColumns {
  services: FooterColumn;
  information: FooterColumn;
}

export interface QuickBook {
  heading: string;
  subtext: string;
  ctaLabel: string;
}

export interface Footer {
  emergencyText: string;
  emergencyCtaLabel: string;
  brandTagline: string;
  copyrightSuffix: string;
  footerTagline: string;
  columns: FooterColumns;
  quickBook: QuickBook;
}

export interface FooterConfig {
  footer: Footer;
}

// ── Assembled site config ─────────────────────────────────────

export type SiteConfig =
  & BrandConfig
  & ContactConfig
  & NavConfig
  & HeroConfig
  & MetricsConfig
  & ServicesConfig
  & WhyChooseConfig
  & HomeCollectionConfig
  & CatalogueConfig
  & TestimonialsConfig
  & DoctorsConfig
  & FaqConfig
  & FooterConfig;
```

## File: llms.txt

# MGPL Diagnostics website

> Public website of Maa Gayatri Path Lab (Arang, Raipur): a Next.js (App Router) single-page site with a GSAP-animated "living lab" 3D scene (Three.js), test catalogue with prices, home sample collection, report download, doctors, testimonials, FAQ and a book-a-test dialog. All copy, prices and contact details live in JSON files under lib/config.

Key facts for agents:
- This Next.js version has breaking changes: read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code (AGENTS.md).
- Edit content in lib/config/*.json (catalogue.json = tests and prices, contact.json, doctors.json, faq.json, …), not in components.
- 3D models in public/models are CC-BY / CC0; credits are in lib/model-credits.ts and must stay rendered in the footer.
- .agents/ and .claude/ hold third-party agent skills (see skills-lock.json); they are tooling, not site code.

## Source

- [app/page.tsx](app/page.tsx): page composition
- [components/](components/): sections (Hero, ServicesGrid, TestCategories, HomeCollection, ReportDownload, DoctorTrust, Testimonials, FAQ, Footer, BookTestDialog)
- [components/three/](components/three/): 3D scene engine, materials, objects
- [lib/config/](lib/config/): site content as JSON
- [lib/model-credits.ts](lib/model-credits.ts): 3D model licences

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent rules
- [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md): original design brief
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every doc and source file in one document
